utv.uk.title: Tonight - Thursday 5 Nov
utv.uk.description: The violent murder of 18-year-old Henry Nowak shocked Britain after footage of his final moments came to light at the trial of his attacker in June. Captured on the police's body-worn camera, false accusations by the aggressor against Henry, alongside his pleas to police as he lay dying, caused national uproar. In an exclusive and deeply revealing interview with ITV's Paul Brand, Henry's family share memories of a much-loved son and brother whose life was cut tragically short, while asking searching questions about the treatment he received, and the police investigation that followed. It is also the story of a family's determination to uncover the truth, secure change and ensure that Henry is remembered not for his tragic murder but for the life he lived. (News) - 1999

utv.uk.title: Deal or No Deal - Amanda
utv.uk.description: The iconic TV series is back, but in a brand-new setting with brand-new prize boxes and a new batch of contestants hoping to win a whopping cash prize - who will have what it takes to beat our brand-new Banker? Now hosted by Stephen Mulhern, the series will see contestants battle it out against the notorious Banker to be in with a chance of winning a life-changing cash prize in a nail-biting game of nerves and intuition. Contestants are confronted with 22 sealed boxes with each one hiding a different amount of money - without knowing what each one contains, the contestant must eliminate the boxes, which are opened one at a time, and the amount of money inside is revealed. Pressure mounts as the player is tempted by the notorious Banker to accept an offer of cash in exchange for what might be inside their box, and as long as the larger cash prizes remain unchosen, the Banker's offers will get higher... but that can all change in an instant if a big cash prize is unveiled. eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys
eden.uk.plus1.description: In Belfast's grand Edwardian City Hall, Michael investigates the scene of a watershed moment in Irish history and hears how thousands of Ulster Protestants were mobilised by train to sign a document pledging opposition to Home Rule for Ireland. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys
eden.uk.plus1.description: Leaving from the seaport of Larne Michael reaches Stranraerand the Mull of Galloway, where in a lighthouse built by railway engineer, Robert Stevenson, he discovers a magnificent machine, installed at the turn of the 20th century. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo continues his journey through western Scotland by exploring the industrial heartland of Glasgow and its mighty River Clyde before taking the ferry to the island of Cumbrae. He is put to work behind the scenes at Glasgow's circular subway, explores the future of shipbuilding on the Clyde. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo falls into line with the University of Glasgow's Officer Training Corps. Founded in the early 20th century, the Corps flourishes today and Michael joins students for drill. From Glasgow, Michael heads west along the Firth of Clyde to Helensburgh, where he discovers a pioneering group of artists known as the Glasgow Boys. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Warwick to Radley
eden.uk.plus1.description: n Warwick's medieval castle he uncovers the scene of an extravagant and scandalous ball, which changed the life of its hostess, Daisy Greville, Countess of Warwick.At Cowley, Michael marvels at a spectacularly automated state-of-the-art production line producing 1,000 Minis a day and probes the pre-First World War origins of the Morris Oxford. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Reading to Taplow
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo picks up his rail journey from Warwick to Rye along the River Thames. In Reading, he traces the origins of education for workers. Messing about in boats is the name of the game in Henley on Thames, where Michael slips into a launch to hear about the world-famous regatta. Afternoon tea on the bank offers a chance to hear about four heroes of early 20th-century literary classic `The Wind in the Willows'. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys

eden.uk.plus1.title: Africa from Above - Zambia
eden.uk.plus1.description: An aerial adventure through the landlocked country of Zambia that takes in sights including the largest migration of mammals on Earth, the huge Victoria Falls, and the meandering Zambezi River.

eden.uk.plus1.title: Africa from Above - Mozambique
eden.uk.plus1.description: Explores the great diversity in natural landscapes and life in the country of Mozambique through visits to the country's Indian Ocean coastline, mountain rainforests, and Zembezi River delta. (Documentary, Nature) - 2022

eden.uk.plus1.title: Africa from Above - Cameroon
eden.uk.plus1.description: Journeys through the diverse landscapes, rich cultures and linguistic customs, and remarkable flora and fauna of Cameroon, a country that sits at the crossroads of West and Central Africa. (Documentary, Nature) - 2022

eden.uk.plus1.title: Africa from Above - Botswana
eden.uk.plus1.description: Explores the great variation in the landscapes of Botswana. Includes visits to the salt pans of the Makgadikgadi, the maze of marshlands and floodplains within the Okavango Delta, and the Kalahari Desert. (Documentary, Nature) - 2022

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Series 3 : Reno to Napa Valley
eden.uk.plus1.description: Beginning in the Silver State of Nevada, Michael takes to the skies over the dramatic Sierra Nevada mountain range. At Lake Tahoe, he hears of the first European explorer, known as `The Pathfinder', whose discovery opened up the west for settlement. Travelling on the historic Virginia and Truckee heritage line, Michael investigates the vast deposits of silver and gold ore on which Virginia City was built. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Series 3 : San Francisco
eden.uk.plus1.description: Armed with his trusty Appleton's Guide, Michael Portillo reaches San Francisco, where he boards one of the city's iconic cable cars. Behind the scenes in the engineering powerhouse, he uncovers the street cars' secret to scaling the city's famously steep hills. In the Presidio neighbourhood, a leading publisher introduces Michael to San Francisco's long tradition of fine printing and book-making. Michael takes the opportunity to have his own treasured book appraised. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Series 3 : Berkeley to Santa Cruz
eden.uk.plus1.description: Following his Appleton's guide, Michael Portillo makes a trip to the jewel in the crown of America's National Parks, Yosemite, to behold its towering granite cliffs, its giant sequoia trees and cascading waterfalls. He discovers how early conservationists fought to protect it in law and encounters a `buffalo soldier' in the heart of the forest. In Berkeley, Michael uncovers a catastrophic event, which hit the city of San Francisco hard in 1906. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Series 3 : Monterey to Los Angeles
eden.uk.plus1.description: Steered by his late 19th-century Appleton's guidebook, Michael Portillo continues through southern California aboard the Coast Starlight rail service. In the historic port of Monterey, Michael raises the Bear Flag of the one-time Republic of California and above it, the Stars and Stripes. He discovers the city's Spanish and Mexican heritage and traces how the former fishing port described as `stinking and decrepit' in John Steinbeck's novel, `Cannery Row', has become a beacon for tourists. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Series 3 : Los Angeles to San Diego
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo strikes oil in the suburbs of Los Angeles, contemplates his navel in the orange groves of Riverside, makes a California roll and paints a pretty picture in Laguna Beach. It is Mexican Independence Day and the locals are celebrating the country's hard-won independence from Spain in the early 19th century. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Boston to Concord
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo's nineteenth-century Appleton's guidebook leads him to the Parker House Hotel, where in his best pinny, he whisks up a Boston cream pie. In the fine dome atop Massachusetts General Hospital, where no-one could hear the screaming, Michael discovers the scene of grisly surgery, first made bearable, in 1846, by a miraculous new substance. North of Boston, in Salem, Michael is caught up in a witch hunt. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Series 3 : Plymouth to New London
eden.uk.plus1.description: Guided by his Appleton's and tracing the footsteps of the Pilgrim Fathers, Michael Portillo heads for Plymouth, the `home town' of America. He learns how indigenous tribes of Wamponoag people taught newly arrived settlers to live off the land, inspiring one of the biggest holidays in today's American calendar. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - New Haven to Plattsburgh: Reversion
eden.uk.plus1.description: Armed with his Appleton's guide, Michael Portillo continues his rail journey through Connecticut and New England. He takes a crash course in rowing in New Haven, where college teams from Yale and Harvard have battled for victory on the water since 1852. In Vermont, Michael visits a 19th-century farm, where the rich milk from prized Jersey cows imported from the British Isles supplied a thriving butter industry. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

stvnorth.uk.title: STV Racing: Live from Cheltenham : 13/11/2026
stvnorth.uk.description: Coverage of day one of the November Meeting, including the Cross Country Handicap Chase and the Albert Bartlettt Novices' Hurdle. With analysis from Mick Fitzgerald, Megan Nicholls and Ruby Walsh, reporting by Oli Bell, Alice Plunkett and Luke Harvey, and commentary from Richard Hoiles.

stvnorth.uk.title: Deal or No Deal
stvnorth.uk.description: S3 E10 Sandra Stephen Mulhern hosts as Sandra tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize.

stvnorth.uk.title: The Chase
stvnorth.uk.description: S17 E127 Bradley Walsh hosts the show where thousands of pounds are at stake. All that stands between Carol-Anne from Liverpool, Jim from Didcot, Rhys from Bristol, Eve from Belfast and that money is one of the country's finest quiz brains.

stvnorth.uk.description: Including regional weather forecast.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV Evening News; Weather

stvnorth.uk.title: Nations Championship : France v South Africa
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E25 France v South Africa (Kick-off 8.10pm). Jill Douglas presents coverage of both teams' second match of the Northern Hemisphere Series, and penultimate contest of the round-robin stage as a whole, held at Stade de France. The Springboks have won nine of the last 10 meetings between the sides, with five of those triumphs coming here, including a 32-17 victory with 14 men when the nations last faced each other 12 months ago. With analysis from Bryan Habana, Benjamin Kayser and Dan Biggar, and commentary by Miles Harrison and Ben Kay.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather

talkingpictures.uk.title: Meet Mr Callaghan

talkingpictures.uk.title: Francis Durbridge's Melissa

amc.us.description: Paid programming. (Consumer, Shopping, Variety)

amc.us.title: The Three Stooges - Pop Goes the Easel
amc.us.description: The Stooges are down and out; with a cop chasing them, they flee into an artists' studio where they are mistaken for students. (Comedy) - 1935-03-29

amc.us.title: The Three Stooges - Slippery Silks
amc.us.description: The Stooges are carpenters who inherit a fancy dress boutique; they put on a fashion show with dresses they've designed based on furniture; during the show, the boys break a Ming vase. (Comedy) - 1936-12-27

amc.us.title: The Three Stooges - Horses' Collars
amc.us.description: Out West, the boys help an innocent maiden recover her inheritance. (Comedy) - 1935-01-10

amc.us.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
amc.us.description: Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes. (Comedy, Adventure) - 1995

amc.us.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
amc.us.description: When the dolphin mascot of Miami's NFL team is abducted, Ace Ventura, a zany private investigator who specializes in finding missing animals, looks into the case. Soon Miami Dolphins players are kidnapped too, including star player Dan Marino, making Ace's sleuth work even more pressing. Working with Dolphins representative Melissa Robinson, Ace closes in on the culprits, but not before many ridiculous misadventures. (Comedy) - 1994

amc.us.title: The Rundown
amc.us.description: Beck (The Rock) is a tight-lipped bounty hunter who doesn't like to use a gun and accepts any job without asking questions. When Beck's employer, Walker (William Lucking), sends him to the Amazon to locate Walker's cocky son, Travis (Seann William Scott), Beck discovers a population controlled by a tyrannical treasure hunter (Christopher Walken). To survive, Beck and Travis must work together, without their affections for a mysterious rebel (Rosario Dawson) getting in the way. (Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2003

amc.us.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
amc.us.description: Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an island where none should exist. Knowing that he will not be able to dissuade Sean from tracking the signal to its source, Hank, Sean's new stepfather, joins the teen on a quest to the South Pacific. Together with helicopter pilot Gabato and Gabato's feisty daughter, Kailani, they set out to find the island and rescue its sole human inhabitant. (Adventure, Fantasy, Action) - 2012

amc.us.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
amc.us.description: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2017

amc.us.title: TNA iMPACT! ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
amc.us.description: TNA Wrestling stars compete each week inside the ring for pride and glory and championship belts; the non-stop action features pro wrestling legends, such as The Hardys and Nic Nemeth, and rising stars such as Leon Slater. (Pro wrestling) - 2026-11-12

amc.us.title: Die Hard
amc.us.description: New York City policeman John McClane is visiting his estranged wife and two daughters on Christmas Eve. He joins her at a holiday party in the headquarters of the Japanese-owned business she works for. But the festivities are interrupted by a group of terrorists who take over the exclusive high-rise, and everyone in it. Very soon McClane realizes that there's no one to save the hostages -- but him. (Action, Thriller) - 1988

amc.us.description: A year after his heroics in L.A., detective John McClane (Bruce Willis) is mixed up in another terrorist plot, this time at Washington Dulles International Airport, where he is waiting for his wife (Bonnie Bedelia). babytv.uk.description: Join Charlie and Princess "Number Two" as they encounter various "two" objects on their way to the "Numbers Party".

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Charlie and Yellow Triangle try to solve a mystery!

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Charlie and Arrow go in search of water in order to water the wilted flowers. They go in search of spiral who helps bring over some clouds.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Princess Star drops her stardust wand. Charlie tries to return it to her but he can't reach. Blue Triangle and Oval come along and try to help.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny count starts together, have fun playing with a feather and fly with a balloon.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny plays with a pair of cymbals, Teeny and Tiny play the music game and "what is hiding beneath the handkerchief".

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny play imaginary games, hide and seek and "what doesn't belong".

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Squirrel is sleeping soundly when the ferry Ki takes him on a magical journey in the sky. Join them as they float through the stars and the moon.

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: Help find the missing butterfly piece! What item is a kitchen utensil in the 3-of-a-kind game along with a pot and pan? A kettle!

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: Help find the cherries piece! What item plays music in the 3-of-a-kind game along with a guitar and a recorder? A drum!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: What a great day for a boat ride! Baby, Hippo, Rabbit, Elephant, Giraffe and Sheep have fun singing Row Your boar while actually rowing their boat!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Ferris wheel, helps grandma get to the balloon shop and the park.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola helps a family of penguins cross the road, helps a cat off a tall tree, finds out what's in the box Jesse has brought Maria.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Ferris wheel, helps Elephant get to the balloon shop and the park.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal has big ears! Come along and learn which animal has a small beak and a funny comb!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Come along and learn which animal has whiskers and funny teeth! Guess who lives in a sheepfold!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: How will the Lollipops cross the broken bridge? With teamwork of course! Come see how they make a flying car out of bubbles!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail is afraid of the dark and his torch has gone out! See the glowing firefly friends he meets!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a stunning butterfly, cute caterpillar and cocoon! Find out how they are related! Mother lays an egg!

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Perry and Harley are hangin laundry on the line, but someone is stealing their clothes? Who can it be? It's a tucan! Join them on a wild goose chase.

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Yay! It's Leo's birthday today and Pix is planning the perfect party. But, sh... sh... sh... it's a surprise. Careful not to wake Leo.

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli has a tough time falling asleep with all the noises he hears in the jungle. He decides to sing to himself which helps him calm down.

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A squeegee arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused squeegee discover its true use?

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A bin arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused bin discover its true use?

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Elephant and Baby Butterfly go on an expedition under the sea in a yellow submarine.

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Johnny is struggling to ride his bike. Mikey says it's because Johnny has grown and needs a bigger bicycle.

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Tommy is tired of always being last. Everyone always has to wait for him because he's the slowest. Can Mike think of something that can help Tommy?

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Petite is dressed up as a cute little mouse and she wants her bike to be dressed up, too. Will Mikey have a costume for her bike?

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a shovel and a sieve! Help Mona dig in the ground and discover an ancient treasure! S1 Ep3

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join the fun as Sketch scribbles wooden planks and tools! Step into the workshop and build a table and chair! S1 Ep8

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Mice Builders are enthusiastically devoted to building their new house. When a messenger arrives with a package, they put down their tools and attempt to guess what's inside.

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they enjoy playing with the spoons on the bowls, creating sounds like a band!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they clean their mess and play an imaginative game with dusters, pretending to be chickens with crests! S1 Ep5

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Baby Hippo is learning how to walk. On his way he meets a flying butterfly, a jumping frog and a crawling snail.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Giraffe and Baby want to sing the friendship song together. Pretty soon the entire bunch are singing and playing to the catchy tune. S1 Ep8

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby wants to play with his friends but they are all busy. Squirrel is working in his garden, Giraffe is cleaning her roof.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Elephant and Baby have come over to Rabbit's house to have some of his delicious carrot cake. S1 Ep10

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Froggy and Ellie blow bubbles in the tub! Ducky wants to join them! Will he fly a bubble plane or hot air balloon?

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Froggy is blowing bubbles in the bathtub! Who's spraying water on him? Come along and find out!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ellie wants to sleep but is covered with paint splashes! Join Ellie and Ducky as they clean themselves in the bath and brush their teeth!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends paint on a sidewalk as the things they paint become real like a fence, steps to climb a mountain and more.

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends celebrate the holidays as the toy slide becomes real and they go on the slide with a reindeer to handout presents.

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends listen to music on the radio as the radio turns into a robot in space.

babytv.uk.title: The Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: The friends put on a special circus show. Join Dodo in an amazing hula hoop act, Uh Oh as he attempts to walk the tight rope.

babytv.uk.title: The Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Uh Oh puts his spare belongings in a sack and takes them out, yet his friends find some of the items of interest and turn them into useful parts. S1 Ep28

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemax.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Scream
cinemax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Man Down
cinemax.us.description: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location. (Thriller, Drama) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemax.us.description: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemax.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Our Kind of Traitor
cinemax.us.description: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis). (Thriller) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: The Watchers
cinemax.us.description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Open Water
cinemax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

cinemax.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemax.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemax.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (Action, Thriller) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
cinemax.us.description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home. (Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

cinemax.us.title: Shut In
cinemax.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. (Thriller) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemax.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Wonka
cinemax.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time. (Family, Musical comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemax.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Won't Back Down
cinemax.us.description: Jamie Fitzpatrick and Nona Alberts are two women from opposite sides of the social and economic track, but they have one thing in common: a mission to fix their community's broken school and ensure a bright future for their children. The two women refuse to let any obstacles stand in their way as they battle a bureaucracy that's hopelessly mired in traditional thinking, and they seek to re-energize a faculty that has lost its passion for teaching. (Drama) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: The Sessions
cinemax.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemax.us.description: The murder of Austria's crown prince leads Holmes (Robert Downey Jr.), Watson (Jude Law) and a Gypsy (Noomi Rapace) to a showdown with an evil genius named Moriarty (Jared Harris). - 2011

cinemax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemax.us.description: After glimpsing his future, an ambitious politician (Matt Damon) battles the agents of Fate itself to be with the woman (Emily Blunt) he loves. - 2011

cinemaxaction.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemaxaction.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Action, Adventure, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2023-06-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Atomic Blonde
cinemaxaction.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, LGBTQ, Movie, Thriller) - 2017-07-28

cinemaxaction.us.title: Companion
cinemaxaction.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire. (Dark comedy, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2025-01-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: Us
cinemaxaction.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2019-03-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Apparition
cinemaxaction.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2012-08-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemaxaction.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2014-02-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: A Hard Day's Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: The Beatles in their feature film debut, one of the greatest rock-and-roll comedy adventures ever. The film has a fully restored negative and digitally restored soundtrack. The film takes on the just-left-of-reality style of mock-documentary, following "a day in the life" of John, Paul, George, and Ringo as fame takes them by storm. (Comedy, Movie, Music, Musical comedy) - 1964-07-06

cinemaxaction.us.title: Blood Simple
cinemaxaction.us.description: "Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea: he follows the two lovers, and... (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1984-07-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Isle of Dogs
cinemaxaction.us.description: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Comedy, Drama) - 2018-02-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman
cinemaxaction.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself "The Joker" (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1989-06-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxaction.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1992-06-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxaction.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1995-06-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxaction.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1997-06-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: Joker
cinemaxaction.us.description: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2019-08-31

cinemaxaction.us.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
cinemaxaction.us.description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Musical) - 2024-09-04

cinemaxaction.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemaxaction.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 2020-02-05

cinemaxaction.us.title: Parental Guidance
cinemaxaction.us.description: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end. (Children, Comedy, Movie) - 2012-12-25

cinemaxaction.us.title: The East
cinemaxaction.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2013-05-31

cinemaxaction.us.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
cinemaxaction.us.description: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Comedy) - 2021-08-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast. (Movie, Science fiction) - 1956-04-27

cinemaxwest.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemaxwest.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemaxwest.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

cinemaxwest.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemaxwest.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy) - 2013

cinemaxwest.us.title: Scream
cinemaxwest.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

cinemaxwest.us.title: Man Down
cinemaxwest.us.description: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location. (Thriller, Drama) - 2015

cinemaxwest.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemaxwest.us.description: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

cinemaxwest.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemaxwest.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemaxwest.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: Our Kind of Traitor
cinemaxwest.us.description: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis). (Thriller) - 2016

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Watchers
cinemaxwest.us.description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

cinemaxwest.us.title: Open Water
cinemaxwest.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

cinemaxwest.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemaxwest.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemaxwest.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemaxwest.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemaxwest.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (Action, Thriller) - 2013

cinemaxwest.us.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
cinemaxwest.us.description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home. (Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxwest.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxwest.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxwest.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

cinemaxwest.us.title: Shut In
cinemaxwest.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. (Thriller) - 2016

cinemaxwest.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemaxwest.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

cinemaxwest.us.title: Wonka
cinemaxwest.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time. (Family, Musical comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemaxwest.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: Won't Back Down
cinemaxwest.us.description: Jamie Fitzpatrick and Nona Alberts are two women from opposite sides of the social and economic track, but they have one thing in common: a mission to fix their community's broken school and ensure a bright future for their children. The two women refuse to let any obstacles stand in their way as they battle a bureaucracy that's hopelessly mired in traditional thinking, and they seek to re-energize a faculty that has lost its passion for teaching. (Drama) - 2012

cinemaxwest.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemaxwest.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

As their operation gets underway, several team members are found to be untrustworthy, and everyone must complete the mission with a watchful eye on everyone else. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1998

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: September 5
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: During the 1972 Munich Olympics, an American sports broadcasting crew finds itself thrust into covering the hostage crisis involving Israeli athletes. (Thriller, Historical drama) - 2024

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Alamo
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In 1836, the Mexican army, led by General Santa Anna, is invading Texas. Hoping to create a diversion for Santa Anna's forces, General Sam Houston (Richard Boone) orders Colonel William B. Travis (Laurence Harvey), joined by Colonels Jim Bowie (Richard Widmark) and Davy Crockett (John Wayne), to lead a small, heroic band of American and Texican fighters in a resistance battle at the Alamo mission. The carnage at the Alamo further spurs the Republic of Texas toward freedom. (Historical drama, War, Western) - 1960

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: We Were Soldiers
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad. (War, Historical drama) - 2002

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: CIA recruit Jack Ryan is caught in a dangerous web of intrigue and espionage spun between a shadowy government agent, his unsuspecting fiancée and a fearless Russian power broker. To stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States, Jack must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative. (Action, Thriller) - 2014

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team race against time to find the Entity, a rogue artificial intelligence that can destroy mankind. (Action, Adventure, Thriller) - 2025

(Fantasy) - 1996

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Moonstruck
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: No sooner does Italian-American widow Loretta (Cher) accept a marriage proposal from her doltish boyfriend, Johnny (Danny Aiello), than she finds herself falling for his younger brother, Ronny (Nicolas Cage). She tries to resist, but Ronny lost his hand in an accident he blames on his brother, and has no scruples about aggressively pursuing her while Johnny is out of the country. As Loretta falls deeper in love, she comes to learn that she's not the only one in her family with a secret romance. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 1987

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Much Ado About Nothing
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In this Shakespearean farce, Hero (Kate Beckinsale) and her groom-to-be, Claudio (Robert Sean Leonard), team up with Claudio's commanding officer, Don Pedro (Denzel Washington), the week before their wedding to hatch a matchmaking scheme. Their targets are sharp-witted duo Benedick (Kenneth Branagh) and Beatrice (Emma Thompson) -- a tough task indeed, considering their corresponding distaste for love and each other. Meanwhile, meddling Don John (Keanu Reeves) plots to ruin the wedding. (Comedy, Romance, Drama) - 1993

mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A lavishly produced and critically acclaimed screen adaptation of the international stage sensation tells the life-affirming story of Tevye, a poor milkman whose love, pride and faith help him face the oppression of turn-of-the-century czarist Russia. (Musical) - 1971

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Yentl
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Rebbe Mendel is a single father who teaches the Talmud, a sacred text of Judaism, to the boys of his small Polish town. Behind closed doors, he also instructs his daughter, Yentl, despite the fact that girls are forbidden to study religious scripture. When Yentl's father dies, she still has a strong desire to learn about her faith -- so she disguises herself as a male, enrolls in a religious school, and unexpectedly finds love along the way. (Musical, Drama, Romance) - 1983

Despite the protests of Oliver's father, the young couple marry. Oliver finds a job at a legal firm in New York City, but their happy life comes crashing down when it's discovered that Jenny has a terminal illness. Together, they try to cope with the situation as best they can. (Romance, Drama) - 1970

movieplex.us.description: Wounded and hovering between life and death, Bat Masterson (Tom Lagleder) revisits the choices he has made and how they have defined his life. (Western) - 2012

movieplex.us.title: H Is for Happiness
movieplex.us.description: An optimistic 12-year-old girl hatches scheme after scheme to make her mother, father and uncle happy again. (Comedy drama) - 2019

movieplex.us.title: City Island
movieplex.us.description: Vince brings home his secret ex-con son to meet the rest of his family, prompting everyone to expose truths. - 2009

movies.us.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
movies.us.description: Investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) springs into action after the arrest of Susan Turner (Cobie Smulders), an Army major accused of treason. Suspecting foul play, Jack embarks on a mission to prove that the head of his old unit is innocent. After crossing paths with the law, Reacher must now go on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers. (Action, Thriller) - 2016

movies.us.title: Shooter
movies.us.description: A top Marine sniper, Bob Lee Swagger, leaves the military after a mission goes awry and disappears without a trace. Swagger is coaxed back into service after high-profile government officials convince him to help thwart a plot against the President of the United States. Swagger realizes he has been betrayed and becomes the target of a nationwide manhunt. Instead of hiding, he seeks revenge against some of the most powerful and corrupt leaders in the free world. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2007

movies.us.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra
movies.us.description: Armed with the latest in military and spy technology, the team of elite soldiers known as G.I. Joe travel around the globe to wherever their services are needed. In their latest assignment Gen. Hawk (Dennis Quaid), Duke (Channing Tatum) and the rest of the G.I. Joe team take on Destro (Christopher Eccleston), a corrupt arms dealer, and fight the growing threat of the mysterious Cobra organization. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2009

movies.us.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
movies.us.description: In the continuing adventures of the G.I. Joe team, Duke (Channing Tatum), second-in-command Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson), and the rest of the Joes (D.J. Cotrona, Lee Byung-hun) face a two-fold threat. Not only is their mortal enemy COBRA rearing its ugly head again, but there is also a threat from within the U.S. government: There might be an impostor in the White House. Meanwhile, Snake Eyes (Ray Park) is on a search for inner peace but learns that his nemesis, Storm Shadow, is still alive. (Action, Adventure) - 2013

movies.us.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation

Cotrona, Lee Byung-hun) face a two-fold threat. movies.us.title: Snake Eyes: G.I. Joe Origins
movies.us.description: An ancient Japanese clan called the Arashikage welcomes tenacious loner Snake Eyes after he saves the life of their heir apparent. Upon arrival in Japan, the Arashikage teach him the ways of the ninja warrior while also providing him something he's been longing for: a home. However, when secrets from Snake Eyes' past are revealed, his honor and allegiance get tested -- even if that means losing the trust of those closest to him. (Family, Action, Adventure) - 2021

movies.us.title: Jackass: The Movie
movies.us.description: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly. (Comedy, Docudrama) - 2002

movies.us.title: Jackass: Number Two
movies.us.description: Daredevils (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O) go for the gross-out when they subject an unsuspecting public to more outrageous stunts and practical jokes. Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy. (Comedy, Docudrama) - 2006

movies.us.title: Jackass 3
movies.us.description: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull." (Comedy, Docudrama) - 2010

movies.us.title: Jackass Forever
movies.us.description: Celebrate the joy of a perfectly executed shot to the groin as Johnny Knoxville, Steve-O and the rest of the gang return for another round of hilarious, wildly absurd and often dangerous displays of stunts and comedy. (Comedy) - 2022

movies.us.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
movies.us.description: Irascible Irving Zisman and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy, set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series. (Comedy) - 2013

movies.us.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
movies.us.description: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman. (Animated, Comedy) - 1996

movies.us.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do the Universe
movies.us.description: Blasting off on a NASA space mission in 1998, mischievous best pals Beavis and Butt-head time travel to the year 2022. As the NSA and U.S. government try to track them down, the clueless teens do their best to adjust to modern life. (Animated, Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure) - 2022

movies.us.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
movies.us.description: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy) - 1999

movies.us.title: Bad Santa
movies.us.description: In this dark comedy, the crotchety Willie (Billy Bob Thornton) and his partner (Tony Cox) reunite once a year for a holiday con. Posing as a mall Santa and his elf, they rip off shopping outlets on Christmas Eve. This year, however, Willie is falling apart. He's depressed and alcoholic, and his erratic behavior draws the suspicion of mall security (Bernie Mac). But when befriending a small boy brings out his kinder side, Willie begins to wonder if there is still some hope for him. (Holiday, Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 2003

movies.us.title: Bad Santa 2
movies.us.description: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Soke (Billy Bob Thornton) teams up with his angry little sidekick, Marcus, to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. Along for the ride is chubby and cheery Thurman Merman, a 250-pound ray of sunshine who brings out Willie's sliver of humanity. Mommy issues arise when the pair are joined by Willie's horror story of a mother, Sunny Soke, who raises the bar for the gang's ambitions, while somehow lowering the standards of criminal behavior. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2016

movies.us.title: Bull
movies.us.description: Ten years after he was last seen, a vicious mob enforcer returns home to find his son and methodically track down the gang that double-crossed him. His quest for revenge soon leads to a savage showdown between his wife and her mob boss father. (Thriller) - 2021

mutv.uk.title: All The Goals: Cantona

mutv.uk.title: All The Goals: Scholes
mutv.uk.description: He scores goals...and lots of them in a fantastic career at United. From a fox in the box to some of the best strikes you'll ever see, this man has scored them all. A true legend.

mutv.uk.title: All The Goals: Beckham
mutv.uk.description: A wonderfully gifted player, David Beckham could strike a ball like no other. With pin-point precision, his free-kicks were a speciality.

mutv.uk.description: The archetypal Captain, Roy was simply magnificent and one of the best midfielders of his generation. The Irish star grabbed many an important goal in his 13 years at Old Trafford.

screenpix.us.title: Bikini Beach
screenpix.us.description: Dee Dee (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon) are primed to hit the beach for some fun in the sun. The only thing standing in the way of their good times is curmudgeonly developer Harvey Huntington Honeywagon (Keenan Wynn), who is intent on turning their teenage hotspot into a grazing ground for seniors. If that weren't bad enough, British rock 'n' roll singer Potato Bug (also Avalon) shows up to spark a summer romance with Frankie's main squeeze -- Dee Dee. (Musical comedy) - 1964

screenpix.us.title: Three on a Spree
screenpix.us.description: An Englishman (Jack Watling) inherits a fortune but must spend a million in 60 days, and prove it, to get it. (Comedy) - 1961

screenpix.us.title: It's a Pleasure
screenpix.us.description: A figure skater's (Sonja Henie) boozing husband (Michael O'Shea) joins an ice show after being barred from hockey for life. (Drama) - 1945

screenpix.us.title: Eight on the Lam
screenpix.us.description: A widower with seven children, Henry Dimsdale (Bob Hope) is employed as a bank teller. After finding $10,000 on the street, Henry takes the money home, but quickly finds out that the cash came from his workplace. Soon Henry is on the run with his kids, while their babysitter, Golda (Phyllis Diller), tries to throw her none-too-bright police officer boyfriend, Jasper Lynch (Jonathan Winters), off their trail. Amid the antics, Henry falls for pretty schoolteacher Ellie Barton (Shirley Eaton). (Comedy) - 1967

screenpix.us.title: The Perez Family
screenpix.us.description: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades. (Comedy drama) - 1995

screenpix.us.title: The Wicked Dreams of Paula Schultz
screenpix.us.description: An East German athlete (Elke Sommer) pole-vaults over the Berlin Wall and falls for a wily American (Bob Crane). (Comedy) - 1968

screenpix.us.title: Masquerade
screenpix.us.description: The British government is in negotiations with the Middle Eastern oil-rich nation of Ramaut to allow in British drilling agencies, but Ramaut withdraws from the talks, leaving Britain desperate. British Col. Drexel (Jack Hawkins) is enlisted in a covert operation to kidnap the Ramaut prince, Jamil (Christopher Witty), in order to force an oil agreement between the countries. Drexel brings in American David Frazer (Cliff Robertson) to assist, but Frazer finds someone else has plans for Jamil. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1965

screenpix.us.title: The Big Knife
screenpix.us.description: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way. (Drama) - 1955

screenpix.us.title: By Love Possessed
screenpix.us.description: After his wife, Clarissa (Barbara Bel Geddes), accuses him of being incapable of love, prominent Massachusetts lawyer Arthur Winner (Efrem Zimbalist Jr.) begins a torrid affair with the alcoholic spouse (Lana Turner) of his sexually disabled business partner Julius Penrose (Jason Robards Jr.). Arthur also struggles in his attempts to persuade his wayward son Warren (George Hamilton) to become a lawyer like him -- even though his own career brought him neither fulfillment nor emotional stability. (Romance) - 1961

screenpix.us.title: Lost Lagoon
screenpix.us.description: Charlie Walker (Jeffrey Lynn), a middle-aged businessman, grows weary of his middle-class life and his family. The stress gets so bad that Walker flees his responsibilities and takes to the open sea in his boat. A storm destroys the vessel, and he winds up stranded on a Caribbean island. Once there, he mixes with the locals and falls in love with a younger woman, Elizabeth Moore (Leila Barry). But Walker starts to feel the strain of his new life and wonders if he made the right decision. (Drama) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: Two for the Seesaw
screenpix.us.description: After leaving his wife, lawyer Jerry Ryan (Robert Mitchum) moves from Omaha, Neb., to New York City to start a new life. While studying for the New York Bar Examination and working to finalize his divorce, Ryan meets dancer Gittel Mosca (Shirley MacLaine), and the two begin a cautious courtship. However, Ryan feels that he must come to terms with his failed marriage and overcome his lingering attachment to his ex-wife before he can redefine himself and embrace his budding romance. (Drama) - 1962

screenpix.us.title: The White Bus
screenpix.us.description: A young woman (Patricia Healey) is removed from her suicidal London life and taken home to North England. (Drama) - 1967

screenpix.us.title: Odds Against Tomorrow
screenpix.us.description: Disgraced former police officer David Burke (Ed Begley) is looking for a way to make some quick money. When he decides to rob a bank, he calls on mean ex-con Earle Slater (Robert Ryan) and black entertainer Johnny Ingram (Harry Belafonte) to help him pull off the heist. Johnny is reluctant to agree but is forced to reconsider because of his significant gambling debts, while racist Earle balks because of Johnny's involvement. Ultimately, though, they must work together to get the job done. (Crime drama) - 1959

screenpix.us.title: The World of Henry Orient
screenpix.us.description: While trying to seduce a married woman (Paula Prentiss), egotistical concert pianist Henry Orient (Peter Sellers) is interrupted by two precocious schoolgirls, Valerie (Tippy Walker) and Marian (Merrie Spaeth). At first, he thinks nothing of it, but as he sees them more often, he becomes convinced they're spies for his lover's husband.
