screenpixaction.us.description: After the sudden death of his millionaire boss, Dave Bishop (Robert Mitchum) begins a quest to discover the source of his mysterious employer's wealth. On a journey that will take Bishop across the European continent, life-threatening encounters lurk around every corner. As Bishop soon finds out, his boss acquired his wealth through underhanded schemes and blackmail. Now that their blackmailer is dead, those who are free want to keep Bishop from taking his place. (Drama) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Pier 5, Havana
screenpixaction.us.description: Miami businessman Steve Daggett (Cameron Mitchell) arrives in Havana in the wake of the revolution, looking for his army buddy Hank (Logan Field), a hard-drinking mechanic who has suddenly vanished. Steve follows a trail that leads him to the apartment of his old flame -- Hank's current wife, Monica (Allison Hayes) -- and to a boat shop where he is beaten up by strangers and warned to leave Cuba. He discovers that Hank's disappearance is linked to a conspiracy to depose Fidel Castro. (Adventure) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: Attack!
screenpixaction.us.description: Lt. Joe Costa (Jack Palance) is a part of Fragile Fox Company, a National Guard unit sent to a Belgian town in the final stages of World War II. Costa harbors some serious doubts about the leadership abilities of Captain Cooney (Eddie Albert), a coward who only secured his position because of his ties to Lt. Col. Bartlett (Lee Marvin). Cooney's inexperience and his open contempt for Costa threaten the lives of his men as they draw closer to Battle of the Bulge. (War, Drama) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Alexander the Great
screenpixaction.us.description: The son of Philip of Macedonia (Fredric March) and Olympias (Danielle Darrieux), Alexander the Great (Richard Burton) is one of the most legendary leaders throughout history. As the Macedonian king, Alexander successfully unites all the ancient Greek tribes and leads them to defeat the imposing Persian Empire. With the fall of Babylon, Alexander continues to conquer most of the known world. Eventually, he achieves the status of unparalleled ruler atop his newly formed Greek empire. (Historical drama) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Billion Dollar Brain
screenpixaction.us.description: Harry Palmer (Michael Caine) is a former British secret agent who has taken up work as a private detective. An anonymous party hires him to deliver a seemingly normal package to Helsinki. However, he learns that he has been deceived into working for the Secret Service again, and is actually returning stolen virus-infected eggs to a government lab. Palmer is then persuaded to thwart a manic Texas oil baron (Ed Begley) who is planning to attack the Soviet Union with a supercomputer. (Drama) - 1967

screenpixaction.us.title: Assassination
screenpixaction.us.description: A Secret Service agent (Charles Bronson) and the president's wife (Jill Ireland) flee from a senator's (Michael Ansara) hit man. (Action) - 1987

screenpixaction.us.title: Triple Deception
screenpixaction.us.description: Police in Paris recruit an English ship's officer (Michael Craig) to help trap counterfeiters by joining them. (Crime drama) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: The Killer Elite
screenpixaction.us.description: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate. (Action) - 1975

screenpixaction.us.title: Sometimes They Come Back
screenpixaction.us.description: High school teacher Jim Norman (Tim Matheson) reluctantly returns to his hometown with his wife (Brooke Adams) to pursue a job. Jim is haunted by the childhood memory of his brother being murdered by a group of teenagers, who were then struck by a train before they could kill him, too. To Jim's horror, he finds that the teenagers have returned to town as they appeared before they died, and are transferring into his class. When his students start dying off, Jim becomes the prime suspect. (Horror) - 1991

screenpixaction.us.title: The Gravedancers
screenpixaction.us.description: After a funeral, several college friends reunite in a cemetery and reminisce about the former life of the deceased. The celebration starts to go too far after they get drunk and begin dancing on graves, and as a result, each of them becomes haunted by malevolent spirits. (Horror, Thriller) - 2006

screenpixaction.us.title: Lovers Lane
screenpixaction.us.description: A man with a hook for a hand escapes from a mental institution to go after the children of his previous victims. (Horror) - 1999

screenpixaction.us.title: Scissors
screenpixaction.us.description: In the wake of a brutal assault suffered at the hands of a red-bearded stranger, Angie Anderson (Sharon Stone) is grappling with her own sanity. To heal her scarred psyche, her therapist (Ronny Cox) urges hypnotherapy, which causes her to face gruesome truths from her past. Not long after getting entangled in a sordid love triangle with twin brothers, Alex (Steve Railsback) and Cole (also Railsback), Angie is lured into a twisted trap that threatens to unravel what little sanity she has left. (Horror) - 1991

screenpixaction.us.title: Scarecrows
screenpixaction.us.description: Bank robbers parachute from a hijacked plane into a field full of killer scarecrows. (Horror) - 1988

screenpixaction.us.title: The Initiation of Sarah
screenpixaction.us.description: When a coed is humiliated by a group of sorority sisters, she is urged to get even by unleashing her psychic powers. (Horror) - 1978

screenpixaction.us.title: The Satan Bug
screenpixaction.us.description: Special Agent Lee Barrett (George Maharis) joins forces with Ann Williams (Anne Francis), a general's daughter, to recover a biological weapon stolen from a secret government lab. Learning that the pathogen could destroy all life on Earth, they focus their attention on a mysterious millionaire who may have orchestrated the theft. After annihilating a small town in Florida, the villain turns his attention to Los Angeles -- and the duo must race to stop the city's destruction. (Science fiction) - 1965

screenpixaction.us.title: The Manster
screenpixaction.us.description: A Japanese scientist's (Tetsu Nakamura) injection splits a U.S. reporter (Peter Dyneley) into man and ape-man. (Science fiction) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: The Vampire
screenpixaction.us.description: A small-town doctor (John Beal) cannot stop taking the pills that turn him into a fanged killer. (Horror) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: The Black Sleep
screenpixaction.us.description: Victorian Sir Joel (Basil Rathbone) prepares for his wife's brain surgery by practicing on locals supplied by a Gypsy (Akim Tamiroff). - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: The Blood on Satan's Claw
screenpixaction.us.description: A judge (Patrick Wymark) tries to stop a witch named Angel (Linda Hayden) and her coven of children in 17th-century England. - 1971

screenpixvoices.us.title: Diggstown
screenpixvoices.us.description: After being released from a Georgia prison, smooth-talking con man Gabriel Caine (James Woods) teams up with his partner in crime, Fitz (Oliver Platt), and travels to remote Diggstown. Upon arriving, Fitz and Caine bet the wealthiest resident, former boxing manager John Gillon (Bruce Dern), that they know a guy who can beat Diggstown's 10 best fighters in one day. After Caine reels in "Honey" Roy Palmer (Louis Gossett Jr.), an aging boxer and old acquaintance, the grift is on. (Action) - 1992

screenpixvoices.us.title: Salt and Pepper
screenpixvoices.us.description: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot. (Comedy) - 1968

screenpixvoices.us.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
screenpixvoices.us.description: Mr. Brooks (Leonard Jackson) is an African-American barbershop owner who runs his household with an iron fist. One day, however, Mrs. Brooks (Clarice Taylor) tires of his stern approach and embraces a nonconformist attitude that's more in line with that of their children, including the philosophical Booker T. (D'Urville Martin) and Gideon (Glynn Turman), a black militant. Soon a battle of wills erupts in the Brooks household, and no one is going to readily back down. (Comedy) - 1973

screenpixvoices.us.title: Amazing Grace
screenpixvoices.us.description: A feisty old woman (Moms Mabley) forces moral support on a big-city candidate (Moses Gunn) for mayor. (Comedy) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Wild Pair
screenpixvoices.us.description: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists. (Action) - 1987

screenpixvoices.us.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
screenpixvoices.us.description: In this sequel to "In The Heat of the Night," Detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) must solve the murder of a prostitute. The last person witnessed with the victim is Tibbs' friend, Logan Sharpe (Martin Landau), a preacher and activist. Despite his loyalty, Tibbs must investigate when Sharpe admits having visited the prostitute. In addition to his police work, Tibbs must also ease tension with his wife (Barbara McNair), who wants him to spend more time with her and their children. (Crime drama) - 1970

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Limbic Region
screenpixvoices.us.description: In San Francisco in the 1970s, a serial killer calling himself The Scorekeeper sends taunting notes to the police and media after each of his kills. Although the case is long closed, obsessed detective Jon Lucca (Edward James Olmos) still suspects the wrong man was named as the killer. Learning he has only weeks to live, Lucca meets with Lloyd Ward (George Dzundza) -- the man he has long been convinced is the murderer, but never had enough evidence to arrest -- intending to force a confession. (Thriller) - 1996

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Ambush Murders
screenpixvoices.us.description: A white lawyer (James Brolin) defends an activist (Dorian Harewood) accused of killing two policemen in a racially tense town. (Drama) - 1982

screenpixvoices.us.title: Deadly Intent
screenpixvoices.us.description: An adventurer's boss (Maud Adams) and other villains want his widow (Lisa Eilbacher) to lead them to his South American jewels. (Thriller) - 1988

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hell up in Harlem
screenpixvoices.us.description: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world. (Crime drama) - 1973

screenpixvoices.us.title: Sugar Hill
screenpixvoices.us.description: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers. (Horror) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Blacula
screenpixvoices.us.description: Los Angeles interior decorators buy the coffin of an African prince (William Marshall) bitten by Dracula centuries before. - 1972

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Wanda Nevada
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the American Southwest of the 1950s, middle-aged vagabond Beaudray Demerille (Peter Fonda) survives as a cardsharp who moves from town to town. But his latest victory brings him unwanted spoils in the form of Wanda Nevada (Brooke Shields), a fiery 13-year-old. At first Beaudray does everything he can to ditch Wanda -- until the girl chances upon a treasure map. But Wanda and Beaudray aren't the only ones after the loot, and they must contend with a ruthless pair of crooks. (Western, Comedy) - 1979

screenpixwesterns.us.title: A Dog's Best Friend
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd. (Children, Drama) - 1960

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Belle of the Yukon
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A con man who has tried to turn over a new leaf, Honest John Calhoun (Randolph Scott) is the owner and operator of a dance hall in the north of Canada. John has hoped to evade both the police and his past, but his history catches up with him when his ex-girlfriend, Belle De Valle (Gypsy Rose Lee), appears in his venue as a member of a dance troupe. As John and Belle reunite, fellow entertainer Lettie Candless (Dinah Shore) also becomes infatuated with the suave businessman. (Musical) - 1944

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Another Man, Another Chance
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Jeanne (Geneviève Bujold), a young woman, falls for a photographer named Francis (Francis Huster), he convinces her to leave war-torn France and move to America with him. After they have set up a photography shop and have a baby, Francis dies. A few years later, Jeanne meets David (James Caan), a solitary man who cannot forget the murder of his wife. Jeanne and David start a relationship, but she worries that his dangerous search for his wife's killers threatens their love. (Romance) - 1977

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Sam Whiskey
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Great gambler Sam Whiskey (Burt Reynolds) has got his hands on a heist job that's pretty outrageous, even by Wild West standards. A drop-dead-gorgeous woman (Angie Dickinson) wants to quietly give back the gold her husband had stolen, now that he's dead. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal. (Western, Comedy) - 1969

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Comanche
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Fleeing to the United States, they come across a band of scalp hunters and are prevented from massacring them by the Comanche chief of the Antelope tribe, Quanah (Kent Smith). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace. (Western) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - General Sherman's March Through Dodge City
screenpixwesterns.us.description: President Hayes and General Sherman are scheduled to make a stop in Dodge City, and Bat takes on the task of protecting the general during the election stop. (Western) - 1958-12-24

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Trail Pirate
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat volunteers to lead a wagon train after the guide for another wagon train is found dead -- the third train lost in a single summer. (Western) - 1958-12-31

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Blood Money
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Writer Jay Pell sets out to create a new legendary bad man for his readers; he persuades an outlaw to hold up a stagecoach so that he can write an eyewitness account; when things go wrong, Sheriff Clay Hollister is tricked into another scheme. (Western) - 1959-11-20

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Premature Obituary
screenpixwesterns.us.description: With his fiancée arriving from London, Ron Browning will do anything to keep her from finding out what a failure he is, even die, at least on paper; his courage in a later crisis may restore his self-respect and save the sheriff at the same time. (Western) - 1959-11-27

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Iroquois Trail
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Trapper Hawkeye (George Montgomery) and guide Sagamore help a British captain (Glenn Langan) in the French and Indian War. (Western) - 1950

(Comedy, Adventure, Action, Drama) - 2010

(Crime drama, Thriller, Action) - 2000

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Molly's Game

showtimeshowcase.us.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Struggling new attorney Rudy Baylor (Matt Damon) resorts to working for a shady lawyer (Mickey Rourke), where he meets paralegal Deck Shifflet (Danny DeVito). When the insurance company of Dot Black (Mary Kay Place) refuses her dying son coverage, Baylor and Shifflet team up to fight the corrupt corporation, taking on its callous lawyer (Jon Voight). Meanwhile, Baylor becomes involved with Kelly Riker (Claire Danes), an abused wife, whose husband complicates matters when he confronts Baylor. (Drama) - 1997

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The King's Speech
showtimeshowcase.us.description: England's Prince Albert must ascend the throne as King George VI, but he has a speech impediment. Knowing that the country needs her husband to be able to communicate effectively, Elizabeth hires Lionel Logue, an Australian actor and speech therapist, to help him overcome his stammer. An extraordinary friendship develops between the two men, as Logue uses unconventional means to teach the monarch how to speak with confidence. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Love Me
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love. (Romance, Science fiction, Drama) - 2024

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Paranormal Activity
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2007

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Paranormal Activity 2
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Core
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Geophysicist Dr. Josh Keyes discovers that an unknown force has caused the Earth's inner core to stop rotating. With the planet's magnetic field rapidly deteriorating, our atmosphere literally starts to come apart at the seams with catastrophic consequences. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core. (Action, Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller, Drama) - 2003

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Cured
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society. (Horror, Thriller, Drama) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Grizzly Night
showtimeshowcase.us.description: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks. (Drama) - 2025

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Wildling
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After a childhood in captivity under the care of a man who taught her to fear the outside world, a young woman sees her new freedom shattered by a series of unsettling events. (Horror, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2018

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Returning after 15 years and calling himself Sweeney Todd, the now-mad man vows revenge, applying his razor to unlucky customers and shuttling the bodies down to Mrs. Lovett (Helena Bonham Carter), who uses them in her meat-pie shop. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat. (Musical, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2007

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Hostage
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After one of his hostage negotiations goes awry, LAPD officer Jeff Talley (Bruce Willis) quits the force and relocates his family to the suburbs. As the sheriff in a sleepy town, Jeff thinks he has escaped the hustle and bustle -- until an elaborate local heist puts him back in the center of a hostage situation. When his own family is pulled into the fray, Jeff is forced to decide whether he should try to help the hostages or follow the criminals' hands-off mandate to protect his own family. (Action, Thriller) - 2005

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Along Came a Spider
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2001

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Shutter Island
showtimeshowcase.us.description: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive. (Thriller, Mystery, Drama) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Fatal Attraction
showtimeshowcase.us.description: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. (Thriller, Drama, Romance) - 1987

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Killer Joe

But Frank is the only one who believes him. Now the father Danny trusts must protect him from the stepfather he fears. (Thriller) - 2001

showtimeshowcase.us.title: House at the End of the Street

Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery. (Thriller, Horror) - 2012

Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew. (Historical drama, Thriller, Biography) - 2012

Ben soon becomes popular with his younger co-workers, including Jules Ostin, the boss and founder of the company. Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules. (Comedy drama) - 2015

All seems well until Michael discovers Madison's whereabouts and re-creates her nightmare. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Heist 88
shoxbetwest.us.description: A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system. (Crime drama) - 2023

shoxbetwest.us.title: American Son
shoxbetwest.us.description: A freshly graduated Marine returns home to his dysfunctional family for Thanksgiving. (Drama) - 2008

shoxbetwest.us.title: Doubt
shoxbetwest.us.description: In 1964 the winds of change are sweeping through Sister Aloysius' (Meryl Streep) St. Nicholas school. Father Flynn (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a charismatic priest, is advocating reform of the school's strict customs, and the first black student has just been accepted. When a fellow nun (Amy Adams) tells Sister Aloysius that Father Flynn may be paying too much personal attention to the student, Sister Aloysius begins a personal crusade against the priest -- despite her lack of evidence. (Thriller, Mystery, Historical drama) - 2008

shoxbetwest.us.title: Breathe
shoxbetwest.us.description: Maya and her young daughter, Zora, are forced to live underground when Earth is left uninhabitable due to a lack of oxygen. When a mysterious couple arrive and claim to know the fate of Maya's husband, she tentatively agrees to let them into the bunker. However, mother and daughter soon find themselves in a fight for survival when the truth about the strangers comes to light. (Science fiction, Thriller) - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: Noah's Arc: Jumping the Broom
shoxbetwest.us.description: Gay couple Noah (Darryl Stephens) and Wade (Jensen Atwood) invite their friends along for a weekend of revelry when they decide to get married in Martha's Vineyard. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2008

shoxbetwest.us.title: One & Done: Ben Simmons
shoxbetwest.us.description: A young man finds success as a basketball player at LSU and prepares for the NBA Draft, in which he is expected to be selected. (Special, Documentary, Basketball) - 2016-10-21

shoxbetwest.us.title: NYC Point Gods
shoxbetwest.us.description: Point guards including Rafer Alston, Kenny Anderson, Mark Jackson, Stephon Marbury, Kenny Smith and Rod Strickland hone their craft and taste for showmanship on New York City's iconic playgrounds and in high school gyms in the 1980s and '90s. (Special, Documentary, Basketball) - 2022-07-29

shoxbetwest.us.title: You're Watching Video Music Box
shoxbetwest.us.description: "Video Music Box," launched in 1983 and hosted in New York City by DJ Ralph McDaniels, showcases hip-hop videos and introduces viewers to future stars like Nas, Jay-Z, LL Cool J, Nicki Minaj and Fat Joe long before they become icons of the genre. (Special, Documentary, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2021-12-03

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Manchurian Candidate
shoxbetwest.us.description: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco (Denzel Washington) finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw (Liev Schreiber), now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return. (Thriller, Drama, Mystery, Science fiction) - 2004

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Fighting Temptations
shoxbetwest.us.description: Advertising executive Darrin Hill (Cuba Gooding Jr.) loses his job and his girlfriend after his many lies about his background and education are discovered. Soon after, he returns to his small Georgia hometown to collect an inheritance from his Aunt Sally (Ann Nesby). To receive it, he must lead the church choir to victory in a gospel competition. With the help of childhood friend Lilly (Beyoncé Knowles), now a beautiful singer, Darrin gets the choir ready to perform. (Comedy) - 2003

shoxbetwest.us.title: Ghost
shoxbetwest.us.description: Sam Wheat (Patrick Swayze) is a banker, Molly Jensen (Demi Moore) is an artist, and the two are madly in love. However, when Sam is murdered by friend and corrupt business partner Carl Bruner (Tony Goldwyn) over a shady business deal, he is left to roam the earth as a powerless spirit. When he learns of Carl's betrayal, Sam must seek the help of psychic Oda Mae Brown (Whoopi Goldberg) to set things right and protect Molly from Carl and his goons. (Fantasy, Romance, Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1990

shoxbetwest.us.title: Virtuosity
shoxbetwest.us.description: A former cop who has been imprisoned for murdering the psychopath who killed his family, Parker Barnes (Denzel Washington) is recruited to test out a new virtual-reality program where the goal is to apprehend a computer-generated being called SID 6.7 (Russell Crowe), who has been modeled on hundreds of deranged criminals. When SID manages to escape into the real world, Barnes must capture or destroy him before the soulless entity can go on a killing spree. (Action) - 1995

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Manchurian Candidate
shoxbetwest.us.description: A troubled Gulf War veteran (Denzel Washington) becomes suspicious after a powerful senator's (Meryl Streep) son (Liev Schreiber) becomes a candidate for vice president. - 2004

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Babe
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Borrowers
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
skycinemafamily.uk.description: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Penguins of Madagascar
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private are recruited by a secret organisation to help bring down an evil supervillain, Doctor Octavius Brine. He holds a grudge against the animals that stole the limelight from him.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hitpig!
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realises that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Swan Princess: The Secret of the Castle
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A princess and prince's wedding anniversary celebrations are rudely interrupted by an evil wizard, who once again wants to conquer the world.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Dr. Seuss' the Lorax
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young boy searches for a way to gain the affections of his dream-girl. In his quest he learns that in order to succeed he must uncover the story of the grumpy but nature-loving Lorax.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Boss Baby
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative Seven-year-old named Tim. The most unusual Boss Baby arrives at Tim's home in a taxi, wearing a suit and carrying a briefcase. The instant sibling rivalry must soon be put aside when Tim discovers that Boss Baby is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hotel Transylvania
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenage daughter.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula decides to put his grandson through 'monster' boot camp. Then, Dracula's father unexpectedly pays a visit.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Dog Man
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Stuart Little
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A New York couple go to an orphanage to adopt a brother for their only son, but instead come away with a little mouse. On arrival at his new home, the diminutive rodent receives a lukewarm welcome by the boy - and an even frostier reception from the pet cat. Featuring a mixture of live action and animation.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Stuart Little 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Sequel to the children's story about the adventures of a small mouse, blending live action and computer-animated characters. The eponymous hero befriends a tiny bird wounded by a sinister falcon, but he must enlist the help of the dreaded family cat if he is to protect his new-found friend.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Dog's Purpose
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Reincarnated as different dogs over the course of five decades, a lovable and devoted canine keeps reuniting with the original owner who cared for it as a young golden retriever puppy.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young farmhand gets swept into the realm of legend when he must defend his land from a seemingly unstoppable force of giant warriors.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Yogi Bear
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from 'Monster Family' to 'The Amazing Maurice'.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Story of the chase for a giant rabbit terrorising a town's allotments and vegetable patches days before the annual vegetable-growing competition. As Wallace and his trusty companion are called into action with their pest control business, a dastardly Lord Victor Quartermaine competes to capture the Were-Rabbit and win the heart of a beautiful lady.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Rugrats Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Rugrats Go Wild
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
skycinemafamily.uk.description: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Madagascar
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Spoiled by their upbringing and with no idea of what wildlife is really like, Alex the lion, Marty the zebra, Gloria the hippo and hypochondriac giraffe Melman swap New York's Central Park Zoo for Madagascar.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The sequel to 'Madagascar', in which New York Zoo animals, Alex the Lion, Marty the Zebra, Melman the Giraffe and Gloria the Hippo, still stranded on Madagascar, start to leave the island. All of a sudden, they land in the wilderness of Africa, where Alex meets the rest of his family, but has trouble communicating with them after spending so much time at the Central Park Zoo. A DreamWorks animation.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hook
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Annie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Daddy Warbucks opens his estate to a spunky orphan in this adaptation of the popular comic strip and hit Broadway show.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Too
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

skykids.uk.description: Very Big Red Riding Hood: Bailey is sick, so Clifford and Emily Elizabeth pack her up a basket of get-well treats. (S1, ep 4)

skykids.uk.description: Finding Time: It's McCoggins' cog-finding competition and Tommy and Tallulah are far too good as they find them all in no time. Their plan to save the day completely backfires! (S1, ep 13)

skykids.uk.description: Exercise Time: The Tickety Townfolk get super tired as Tommy and Tallulah try to get everyone exercising and Pufferty's wheels prove especially hard to wake before Chime Time! (S1, ep 14)

skykids.uk.description: Bubble Time: Tommy and Tallulah unleash a giant unpoppable bubble in Tickety Town and Hopparoo is tasked with popping the unpoppable. Can it be done?! (S1, ep 15)

skykids.uk.title: Tickety Toc
skykids.uk.description: Dress Up Time: Tommy and Tallulah are determined to surprise Hopparoo with their new outfits, but the spring chicks quickly become terrified - and block the way to Chime Time! (S1, ep 16)

skykids.uk.title: Tickety Toc
skykids.uk.description: Make a Pot Time: Tommy and Tallulah break Madame Au Lait's pot and try to make a replacement. But pottery is harder than it looks and soon the whole town is splattered in clay! (S1, ep 17)

skykids.uk.title: Tickety Toc
skykids.uk.description: Measuring Time: The twins try to help Hopparoo grow by finding him a huge pair of stilts. Before Chime Time, they must bring the rampaging bunny back down to the ground. (S1, ep 18)

skykids.uk.title: Tickety Toc
skykids.uk.description: Pirate Time: Tommy and Tallulah play pirates and hunt for Madame Au Lait's treasure. Hopparoo has a plan of his own involving a cardboard boat and tries to get his hands on it! (S1, ep 19)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: Beverly Beaver: Beverly is obsessed with building dams and ignores her friends' pleas to stop before disaster strikes - which it does! She later makes amends with their help. (S1, ep 22)

skykids.uk.description: Doris the Duck: A game of make believe takes a twist when Princess Doris of the Zambam goes too far... that is until her chums Toby and Kevin teach her a lesson! (S1, ep 23)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: Esmerelda the Snake: A tidy snake regrets her kind offer of a shared burrow when Herbert the Warthog moves in. After a bump in the road, they appreciate what they had together. (S1, ep 24)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: Eddie's Big Adventure: Eddie's inquisitive nature leads him into all sorts of problems... and it's nearly curtains when help appears from an unexpected source. (S1, ep 25)

skykids.uk.description: Herbert's Birthday Party: Herbert the Warthog has a makeover in order to crash his own surprise party. His friends don't recognise him... until he returns to his normal self! (S1, ep 26)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of Reginald's Big Sleep: Reginald creates a no-noise zone around him and finds the grass has literally grown under his feet. Normality is restored when he apologises. (S2, ep 1)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of the Dawn Chorus: Doris thinks the normal Dawn Chorus is too disorganised. However, she finds being a maestro hard work, especially when the singers go off in a huff! (S2, ep 2)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of Phoebe the Koala: Phoebe gets caught out when trying to take credit for someone else's work. However, she finds her artistic feet with help from Wally the Wombat. (S2, ep 3)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of Hercule Moustache: Sidney and Snowbert show their guest Hercule all the sites. At first he's unimpressed and is even a bit rude - but the best is yet to come! (S2, ep 4)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of Kevin's Magic Trick: Kevin pretends he is magic and an impressed Doris makes him do a show. A special cloud comes to Kevin's aid and makes it a wonderful occasion. (S2, ep 5)

skykids.uk.description: Pingu Glides to Fame: Pingu and Pinga begin figure skating after watching skaters at the rink. As the crowd cheers them on, the two take their ice show into the city. (S1, ep 18)

skykids.uk.description: Pingu Gets a Warning / Pingu and the Magnet: Pingu's friend warns Pingu to be careful with his kite, but Pingu ignores him. Pingu uses a magnet to dupe his friend. (S2, ep 18)

starz.us.title: Fifty Shades of Grey (Extended Version)
starz.us.description: When college senior Anastasia Steele (Dakota Johnson) steps in for her sick roommate to interview prominent businessman Christian Grey (Jamie Dornan) for their campus paper, little does she realize the path her life will take. Christian, as enigmatic as he is rich and powerful, finds himself strangely drawn to Ana, and she to him. Though sexually inexperienced, Ana plunges headlong into an affair -- and learns that Christian's true sexual proclivities push the boundaries of pain and pleasure. (Romance, Drama) - 2015

starz.us.title: Fifty Shades Darker: Extended Version
starz.us.description: When a wounded Christian Grey tries to entice a cautious Anastasia Steele back into his life, she demands a new arrangement before she will give him another chance. As the two begin to build trust and find stability, shadowy figures from Christian's past start to circle them, determined to destroy their hopes for a future together. (Romance, Drama) - 2017

starz.us.title: Fifty Shades Freed: Extended Version
starz.us.description: Believing they've left behind the shadowy figures from the past, billionaire Christian Grey and his new wife, Anastasia, fully embrace their inextricable connection and shared life of luxury. Just as the Greys begin to step into their new roles, sinister events come to light and jeopardize their happy ending before it even begins. (Romance, Drama) - 2018

starz.us.title: Marshall
starz.us.description: Young Thurgood Marshall faces one of his greatest challenges while working as a lawyer for the NAACP. Marshall travels to conservative Connecticut when wealthy socialite Eleanor Strubing accuses Black chauffeur Joseph Spell of sexual assault and attempted murder. He soon teams up with Sam Friedman, a local Jewish lawyer who's never handled a criminal case. Together, the two men build a defense while contending with racist and anti-Semitic views from those who deem Spell to be guilty. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2017

starz.us.title: Curve
starz.us.description: A young woman becomes trapped in her wrecked car after a hitchhiker causes an accident. (Horror, Thriller) - 2015

starz.us.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
starz.us.description: When Tony Stark (Robert Downey Jr.) jump-starts a dormant peacekeeping program, things go terribly awry, forcing him, Thor (Chris Hemsworth), the Incredible Hulk (Mark Ruffalo) and the rest of the Avengers to reassemble. As the fate of Earth hangs in the balance, the team is put to the ultimate test as they battle Ultron, a technological terror hell-bent on human extinction. Along the way, they encounter two mysterious and powerful newcomers, Pietro and Wanda Maximoff. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2015

starz.us.title: Pixels
starz.us.description: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet. (Comedy, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2015

starz.us.title: The Night Before
starz.us.description: For the last 10 years, lifelong buddies Ethan (Joseph Gordon-Levitt), Isaac (Seth Rogen) and Chris (Anthony Mackie) have gathered on Christmas Eve to celebrate the holidays with a bang. As Isaac prepares to become a first-time father, the friends realize that their annual tradition is coming to a sad end. To make it as memorable as possible, they plan a night of debauchery and hilarity by searching for the Nutcracka Ball, the Holy Grail of Christmas parties in New York. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2015

starz.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
starz.us.description: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance) - 1999

starz.us.title: Enough
starz.us.description: Working-class waitress Slim (Jennifer Lopez) finds her life transformed when she marries wealthy contractor Mitch (Billy Campbell). She settles into an idyllic suburban life and seems to have everything she wants. Her dream is shattered when she discovers her husband is anything but perfect. His abusive behavior forces her to go on the run, eluding an increasingly obsessive Mitch and his lethal henchman. (Thriller, Drama) - 2002

starz.us.title: Brick Mansions
starz.us.description: In a dystopian Detroit, grand houses that once housed the wealthy are now homes of the city's most-dangerous criminals. Surrounding the area is a giant wall to keep the rest of Detroit safe. For undercover cop Damien Collier (Paul Walker), every day is a battle against corruption as he struggles to bring his father's killer, Tremaine (RZA), to justice. Meanwhile, Damien and an ex-con named Lino (David Belle) work together to save the city from a plot to destroy it. (Action, Crime drama) - 2014

Their gang leader, Lino, decides to use Gloria for his dirty work to avoid detection from the Drug Enforcement Administration. Determined to get away, Gloria must now play a dangerous game to outwit not only the cartel, but the DEA agents who suspect her of complicity. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Adventure) - 2019

Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet. (Comedy, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2015

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Salt
starzencoreclassic.us.description: When Evelyn Salt (Angelina Jolie) became a CIA officer, she swore an oath to duty, honor and country. But, when a defector accuses her of being a Russian spy, Salt's oath is put to the test. Now a fugitive, Salt must use every skill gained from years of training and experience to evade capture, but the more she tries to prove her innocence, the more guilty she seems. (Action, Thriller) - 2010

starzencoreclassic.us.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days

Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. starzwest.us.title: Enough
starzwest.us.description: Working-class waitress Slim (Jennifer Lopez) finds her life transformed when she marries wealthy contractor Mitch (Billy Campbell). His abusive behavior forces her to go on the run, eluding an increasingly obsessive Mitch and his lethal henchman. (Thriller, Drama) - 2002

starzwest.us.title: Fifty Shades of Grey (Extended Version)
starzwest.us.description: When college senior Anastasia Steele (Dakota Johnson) steps in for her sick roommate to interview prominent businessman Christian Grey (Jamie Dornan) for their campus paper, little does she realize the path her life will take. Christian, as enigmatic as he is rich and powerful, finds himself strangely drawn to Ana, and she to him. Though sexually inexperienced, Ana plunges headlong into an affair -- and learns that Christian's true sexual proclivities push the boundaries of pain and pleasure. (Romance, Drama) - 2015

starzwest.us.title: Fifty Shades Darker: Extended Version

starzwest.us.title: Fifty Shades Freed: Extended Version

starzwest.us.title: Marshall
starzwest.us.description: Young Thurgood Marshall faces one of his greatest challenges while working as a lawyer for the NAACP. Marshall travels to conservative Connecticut when wealthy socialite Eleanor Strubing accuses Black chauffeur Joseph Spell of sexual assault and attempted murder. He soon teams up with Sam Friedman, a local Jewish lawyer who's never handled a criminal case. Together, the two men build a defense while contending with racist and anti-Semitic views from those who deem Spell to be guilty. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2017

teennick.us.description: Lola and Lana try out for Bluebell Scouts, but discover one of them might be more suited for it; when Lincoln and Clyde think Bobby is cheating on Lori, they follow him around town gathering evidence. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2017-03-16

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Roll Model With the Casagrandes; No Show With the Casagrandes
teennick.us.description: When Carl witnesses Ronnie Anne save a dog, he becomes obsessed with being just like his newfound hero; Ronnie Anne secretly starts watching her family's favorite telenovela after refusing to watch it with them. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2019-06-13

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Attention Deficit; Out on a Limo
teennick.us.description: Lincoln begins spending time at Clyde's house when Clyde's fathers give him more attention than he gets at home; when Lincoln wins a ride in a limo, he begins to change after getting a taste of the good life. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-08-03

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Out of Step; Too Cool for School
teennick.us.description: Clyde and Nana Gayle are in stiff competition when they make the finals of a Grandmother/Grandson Dance Contest; Lincoln and friends need to get school back to normal when Principal Ramirez implements new fishy rules. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2023-09-05

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Hurt Lockers; Love Stinks
teennick.us.description: When a sinkhole opens up at school, Lincoln and his classmates are forced to share lockers; when Lana brings home a skunk to rehabilitate, Lola grows attached when she finds the skunk has finer tastes. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2023-05-16

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Brawl in the Hall
teennick.us.description: When Charlotte is challenged to a fight at school, Captain Man and Kid Danger step in to try and help Charlotte defend herself. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-11-04

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Grand Theft Otto
teennick.us.description: When Piper's school parrot, Otto, starts to repeat that Henry is Kid Danger, Henry and Jasper have to stall until Ray, Charlotte and Schwoz can find a way to fix things. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-02-16

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - License to Fly
teennick.us.description: Ray agrees to let Henry fly his helicopter, but Ray starts to act like a nervous parent; Charlotte, Jasper and Piper find a cotton candy machine. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-04-15

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Great Cactus Con
teennick.us.description: Jasper gets the chance to take his crush to Cactus Con, but when a mysterious villain gets involved in the convention, the entire gang is forced into action. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-11-24

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Car Trek
teennick.us.description: Charlotte's birthday road trip to see the Boo Man Group perform gets sidetracked by a Captain Man and Kid Danger emergency. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-04-28

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Mr. Nice Guy
teennick.us.description: A vigilante in a smiley-face mask punishes Swellviewians for being rude in public; Kid Danger and Captain Man's investigation leads them to the TV set of Mr. Wallabee, a local TV celebrity who hosts a show for children. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-01-11

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Henry's Jelly
teennick.us.description: After Jasper is lauded for being a local hero, Henry becomes jealous that Kid Danger is the one getting all the thanks. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-11-21

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Text, Lies & Video
teennick.us.description: When a video of Henry and Ray transforming into Kid Danger and Captain Man gets out, Henry must go to great lengths to retrieve it and protect his secret identity. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-04-09

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Whistlin' Susie
teennick.us.description: After activating an atomic bomb in the Man Cave, Ray and Henry decide to drive it out into the Swellview desert in order to save their city. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-11-10

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Jasper's Real Girlfriend
teennick.us.description: When Jasper's summer camp girlfriend comes to town, she quickly grows jealous thinking that Charlotte is in love with Jasper. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-05-16

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Mouth Candy
teennick.us.description: When Jasper is falsely accused of a burglary and sent to jail, Henry and Ray must find a way to set him free. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-10-08

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Love Bytes
teennick.us.description: Things get a little buggy when Schwoz installs a new operating system on the Man Cave computer designed to detect and eliminate threats all over Swellview. (Children, Comedy, Action, Science fiction) - 2019-06-22

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Knight & Danger
teennick.us.description: When the Knight Squad's archenemy, Ryker, is unleashed on Swellview, Kid Danger and Captain Man take him down to Burger Castle only to be tricked into joining forces with the villain. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-02-02

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Gas or Fail
teennick.us.description: When Captain Man finds himself trapped underground, Henry must devise a way to sneak out of his school's standardized testing to save Ray. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-03-25

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Nothing to Lose Sleepover
teennick.us.description: Phoebe is caught using telekinesis to save her first sleepover from becoming a disaster; Phoebe must wear an anklet that prevents her from using her powers. (Children, Sitcom, Action, Adventure) - 2014-04-26

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Ditch Day
teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe create some fun for themselves on Ditch Day. (Children, Sitcom, Adventure, Action) - 2013-11-23

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Can't Spy Me Love
teennick.us.description: Unexpected consequences arise when Phoebe uses the Hero League's villain search software to track down a cute boy. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-07-23

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Change of Art
teennick.us.description: When Phoebe gets help from Billy on an art project, she learns that he took the piece from a museum. (Children, Sitcom) - 2014-11-22

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Back to School
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max return to their elementary school to complete a hero assessment exam and discover that the instructor is a former classmate that Max tormented.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Max's Minions
teennick.us.description: Max takes on a group of freshmen to be his minions; Max becomes the victim of a humiliating prank.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - You've Got Fail
teennick.us.description: Max tries to win an epic-fail video contest by submitting a video of Phoebe as she practices ballet, but Phoebe refuses to cooperate.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - From Dust Till Dawn
teennick.us.description: Chloe struggles with her leadership skills; when a villain attacks her school field trip, Max and Phoebe have to put Chloe in charge while they try to take down the villain and defuse his dangerous astronomical weapon.

themoviechannel.us.title: Private Parts
themoviechannel.us.description: The life and career of shock-jock superstar Howard Stern (himself) is recounted from his humble beginnings to his view from the top. Possessing a desire to be an on-air personality since childhood, Stern meanders through the radio world, always with his supportive wife, Alison (Mary McCormack), by his side. Landing a gig in Washington, D.C., Stern meets Robin Quivers (herself), who will become his long-time partner in crime. When the two move to New York, they face the wrath of NBC executives. (Biography, Comedy) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Doin' It
themoviechannel.us.description: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. (Comedy) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: 68 Kill
themoviechannel.us.description: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is. (Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Thriller) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: The Ruins
themoviechannel.us.description: Amy (Jena Malone), Stacy (Laura Ramsey), Jeff (Jonathan Tucker) and Eric (Shawn Ashmore) look for fun during a sunny holiday in Mexico, but they get much more than that after visiting an archaeological dig in the jungle. Carnivorous vines try to ensnare the friends in their tendrils, forcing the group to fight for survival. (Horror, Thriller, Adventure, Action, Mystery) - 2008

themoviechannel.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
themoviechannel.us.description: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: The Core
themoviechannel.us.description: Geophysicist Dr. Josh Keyes discovers that an unknown force has caused the Earth's inner core to stop rotating. With the planet's magnetic field rapidly deteriorating, our atmosphere literally starts to come apart at the seams with catastrophic consequences. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core. (Action, Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller, Drama) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Sleeping Dogs
themoviechannel.us.description: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Cop Land
themoviechannel.us.description: When hotheaded Superboy (Michael Rapaport) accidentally gets involved in an ugly racially-motivated incident, his uncle Ray Donlan (Harvey Keitel), a corrupt New York City cop, attempts to sweep it under the rug by helping fake his nephew's death. The bungled cover-up leads to investigations by idealistic Internal Affairs officer Moe Tilden (Robert De Niro) and Freddy Heflin (Sylvester Stallone), sheriff of the suburban New Jersey town where Donlan and his fellow crooked policemen live. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Machete Kills
themoviechannel.us.description: When the president (Carlos Estevez) of the United States has a mission that would be impossible for just any mortal man, the person he needs is Machete (Danny Trejo), a knife-wielding ex-Federale agent. Machete's mission is to take down Voz (Mel Gibson), a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has come up with a plot to start a nuclear war. Facing death at every turn from assassins, Machete pulls out all of his skills to get the job done. (Action) - 2013

themoviechannel.us.title: Haunter
themoviechannel.us.description: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living. (Horror, Thriller) - 2013

themoviechannel.us.title: Peep World
themoviechannel.us.description: Revelations arise when members (Michael C. Hall, Sarah Silverman) of a dysfunctional Jewish family gather to celebrate the patriarch's (Ron Rifkin) 70th birthday. (Comedy) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: The Comeback Trail
themoviechannel.us.description: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making. (Comedy) - 2020

themoviechannel.us.title: Love & Basketball
themoviechannel.us.description: Monica (Sanaa Lathan) and Quincy (Omar Epps) are two childhood friends who both aspire to be professional basketball players. Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart. (Romance, Drama) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Shall We Dance?
themoviechannel.us.description: Despite having a great career and a loving family, lawyer John Clark (Richard Gere) is missing something in his life as he meanders listlessly from day to day. On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret. (Romantic comedy, Drama, Music) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Urban Cowboy
themoviechannel.us.description: After moving to Pasadena, Texas, country boy Bud Davis starts hanging around a bar called Gilley's, where he falls in love with Sissy, a cowgirl who believes the sexes are equal. They eventually marry, but their relationship is turbulent due to Bud's traditional view of gender roles. Jealousy over his rival, Wes, leads to their separation, but Bud attempts to win Sissy back by triumphing at Gilley's mechanical bull-riding competition. (Drama) - 1980

themoviechannel.us.title: Blue Valentine
themoviechannel.us.description: Dean (Ryan Gosling) and Cindy (Michelle Williams) live a quiet life in a modest neighborhood. To the casual observer, everything appears normal, if a bit subdued. But a closer examination reveals a couple caught in a downward spiral. They appear to have the world at their feet at the outset of the relationship. However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage. (Drama, Romance) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Our Ghosts
themoviechannel.us.description: Hiding in the attic of his former apartment, a widowed and jobless father tries to scare the new tenant so he can live there once again. (Comedy drama) - 2021

themoviechannel.us.title: The Aviator
themoviechannel.us.description: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Wakefield
themoviechannel.us.description: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. (Drama) - 2016

themoviechannel.us.title: Red Eye
themoviechannel.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. (Action, Thriller) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: The Contractor
themoviechannel.us.description: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. (Action, Thriller) - 2022

themoviechannel.us.title: Paycheck
themoviechannel.us.description: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller, Mystery) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Along Came a Spider
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Primal Fear
themoviechannel.us.description: A publicity-seeking Chicago lawyer (Richard Gere) vies with an embittered ex-lover (Laura Linney) prosecuting an altar boy (Edward Norton) in a high-profile murder case. - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Barron's Cove
themoviechannel.us.description: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps. - 2024

theweatherchannel.us.title: Weather Unfiltered
theweatherchannel.us.description: Uncensored take on weather and storms from an expert trio as unpredictable as nature itself. (Weather) - 2024-05-13

theweatherchannel.us.title: Weather Unfiltered
theweatherchannel.us.description: Uncensored take on weather and storms from an expert trio as unpredictable as nature itself. (Weather) - 2024-05-13

theweatherchannel.us.title: Deep Water Salvage - Emergency!
theweatherchannel.us.description: Responding to an emergency call, Northstar marine sets out to salvage a sunken tug in the Delaware Bay; following the devastation caused by Hurricane Sally, Capt. Chris Ward and his crew work to salvage sunken sailboats and wrecked powerboats. (Weather, Reality) - 2021-05-02

theweatherchannel.us.title: Deep Water Salvage - America's Biggest Shipwreck
theweatherchannel.us.description: A mysterious object is raised from the depths of the ocean; a stranded speedboat; an elite crew works to salvage America's biggest shipwreck before hurricane season. (Weather, Reality) - 2021-05-16

theweatherchannel.us.title: Deep Water Salvage - The Moment of Truth
theweatherchannel.us.description: A salvage maestro returns to raise more valuable tropical hardwood trying not to wreck his own boat in the process; the multimillion dollar operation to salvage America's biggest shipwreck. (Weather, Reality) - 2021-05-23
