turnerclassicmovies.us.title: In Harm's Way
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Naval Captain Torrey (John Wayne) manages to bring his ship through the bombing of Pearl Harbor unscathed, but is later demoted when it is damaged in a subsequent battle due to his negligence. Back on land, he begins a reconciliation with his estranged son (Brandon de Wilde) and a romance with nurse Maggie (Patricia Neal), but duty calls him away when he and his firebrand friend, Cmdr. Paul Eddington (Kirk Douglas), are tasked with salvaging a dangerous and important mission. (War, Drama) - 1965

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Adaptation of the Pierre Boulle novel about POWs in Burma forced to build a bridge to aid the war effort of their Japanese captors. British and American officers plot to blow up the structure, but the commander of the bridge's construction has different plans. (War, Drama) - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Deer Hunter
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1968, Michael (Robert De Niro), Nick (Christopher Walken) and Steven (John Savage), lifelong friends from a working-class Pennsylvania steel town, prepare to ship out overseas following Steven's elaborate wedding and one final group hunting trip. In Vietnam, their dreams of military honor are quickly shattered by the inhumanities of war; even those who survive are haunted by the experience, as is Nick's hometown sweetheart, Linda (Meryl Streep). (War, Drama) - 1978

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: MGM Parade Show
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films. (Special, Drama) - 2005-12-09

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Fox
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Headstrong Ellen (Anne Heywood) and her more demure lesbian lover, Jill (Sandy Dennis), pass their time together on an isolated farm in backwoods Canada. While Jill longs for nothing more than their life together, Ellen is becoming discontented with their relationship. The farm's former owner's grandson, Paul (Keir Dullea), arrives unannounced and asks to spend the rest of his leave from the Merchant Marines living and working on the farm. But Ellen's attraction to him could be disastrous. (Drama) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sweet November
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sara (Sandy Dennis), a free-spirited single woman living in Brooklyn, invites a new man to stay with her every month. For Sara, this is an opportunity to expose a man to new things, but it's also a way to make sure she will always be remembered by someone. Her latest boarder is Charlie (Anthony Newley), an uptight British businessman. Things, however, don't go as planned, and the two fall in love. Despite this, Charlie cannot stay any longer than his allotted month. (Comedy drama) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: High Society
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jazz artist C.K. Dexter Haven (Bing Crosby) is still hung up on his ex-wife and neighbor, socialite Tracy Samantha Lord (Grace Kelly), however Tracy is engaged to another man (John Lund). Matters are complicated even further when a magazine reporter (Frank Sinatra), in town to cover Tracy's wedding, also winds up falling for the beautiful bride-to-be. As Tracy tries to decide on the ideal husband, each suitor works hard to convince her he is the best choice. (Musical comedy) - 1956

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Green Fire
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the mountains of Colombia, engineer and explorer Rian Mitchell (Stewart Granger) finds an enormous emerald mine thought to have been first discovered by Spanish conquistadors centuries before. Driven by avarice, Mitchell feuds with his more circumspect business partner, Vic Leonard (Paul Douglas), the beautiful owner of the nearby coffee plantation (Grace Kelly), her headstrong brother (John Ericson) and a band of local outlaws who want the emerald mine for themselves. (Romance) - 1954

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mogambo
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Victor Marswell (Clark Gable) is a big-game hunter in Kenya. After Eloise Kelly (Ava Gardner) is stood up by a friend there, she falls in with Marswell. Shortly thereafter, the Nordleys (Grace Kelly, Donald Sinden) arrive for a gorilla safari. Mrs. Nordley, disillusioned with her husband, takes a liking to Marswell, and the two have a brief affair. Kelly grows jealous, and the two women engage in a battle of wills over the hunter, while Mr. Nordley remains oblivious to it all. (Adventure) - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dial M for Murder
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Ex-tennis pro Tony Wendice (Ray Milland) wants to have his wealthy wife, Margot (Grace Kelly), murdered so he can get his hands on her inheritance. When he discovers her affair with Mark Halliday (Robert Cummings), he comes up with the perfect plan to kill her. He blackmails an old acquaintance into carrying out the murder, but the carefully-orchestrated set-up goes awry, and Margot stays alive. Now Wendice must frantically scheme to outwit the police and avoid having his plot detected. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1954

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Swan
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Prince Albert, who is scouring Europe for a wife, arrives in a tiny town to visit a banished family of nobles. Their matriarch, Beatrix, wants her daughter, Alexandra, to marry Albert so that her family will be welcomed back into the kingdom. In order to rouse Albert's attention, Alexandra flirts with her attractive tutor, Dr. Agi; however, Alexandra's plan hits a snag when she develops genuine feelings for Dr. Agi. (Romantic comedy) - 1956

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Love With the Proper Stranger
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Angie Rossini (Natalie Wood), an innocent New York City sales clerk from a repressive Italian-American family, engages in a short-lived affair with a handsome jazz musician named Rocky Papasano (Steve McQueen). When Angie becomes pregnant, she tracks down Rocky hoping he'll pay for her abortion. Rocky agrees to help, but after seeing the unsanitary abortion facility, he refuses to let Angie go through with the procedure and attempts to make her an honest woman. (Comedy drama) - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Come September
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: American mogul Robert L. Talbot (Rock Hudson) customarily spends the month of September in his lush Italian villa. But this year he arrives early and gets a surprise — his money-grubbing overseer has turned the villa into a hotel in his absence. Infuriated, Talbot is ready to kick his teenage guests out at first — until he unexpectedly takes on the role of chaperon. Meanwhile, the playboy fights to save his on-the-rocks relationship with feisty Italian Lisa Fellini (Gina Lollobrigida). (Romantic comedy) - 1961

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Same Time, Next Year
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1951, at a small California inn, George (Alan Alda) and Doris (Ellen Burstyn) have an affair. Instead of writing it off as a one-night stand, the pair decide to meet at the inn every year for a romantic retreat, away from their respective spouses and families. In the decades that follow, both George and Doris face their own personal struggles and hardships, and together they develop a level of love and intimacy that exceeds the ones found in their own marriages. (Comedy drama) - 1978

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Man in the Moon
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Maureen Trant (Emily Warfield) and her younger sibling Dani (Reese Witherspoon) share a strong connection, but local boy Court Foster (Jason London) threatens to throw their bond off balance. Dani and Court meet first and have a flirtatious rapport -- but when he meets Maureen, he falls hard and they begin a passionate affair. The new couple try to keep their love hidden from Dani, but she soon learns the truth, disavowing her sister. But a heartbreaking accident later reunites the girls. (Drama, Romance) - 1991

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Up the Down Staircase
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: On her first day at Calvin Coolidge High, fledgling teacher Sylvia Barrett (Sandy Dennis) encounters an apathetic faculty, a delinquent student body and an administration that drowns its staff in paperwork. The following days go from bad to worse as Sylvia struggles to reach her most troubled students, bright underachiever Joe and sensitive Alice. When Alice's crush on a male teacher (Patrick Bedford) leads her to attempt suicide, Sylvia questions her ability to help the disadvantaged teens. (Drama) - 1967

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: In the Cool of the Day
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Young couple Sam (Arthur Hill) and Christine Bonner (Jane Fonda) are struggling in their marriage. Sam's devotion to his wife is intense, but Christine wants a little bit of breathing room. When he introduces her to his co-worker, Murray Logan (Peter Finch), who is unhappily married to Sybil (Angela Lansbury), there are immediate sparks between Christine and Murray, and as their respective marriages disintegrate, the two begin to look for a way to be together. (Drama) - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sunday in New York
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Troubled over pressure from her boyfriend (Robert Culp) to have sex, prim and proper Eileen Tyler (Jane Fonda) decides to visit her brother Adam (Cliff Robertson), a pilot who has an apartment in New York City. After comforting Eileen, Adam departs to meet his lover, Mona Harris (Jo Morrow), leaving his sister on her own in Manhattan. While out and about, Eileen meets the handsome Mike Mitchell (Rod Taylor), and the two spend a romantic afternoon together. (Romantic comedy) - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Thirteen Women
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Female alumnae of the St. Albans Seminary sorority group receive letters from Swami Yogodachi, making alarming predictions of death and murder -- which come true. When Helen Frye (Kay Johnson) receives her prediction, she contacts sorority leader Laura Stanhope (Irene Dunne), who invites the remaining members to come to her home. On the journey there, Helen meets Ursula Georgi (Myrna Loy), a half-Indian, unaware that Ursula's fury over her treatment in college is behind the swami's predictions. (Thriller) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Thirteenth Chair
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A medium holds a seance to clear her daughter of murder in colonial India. (Mystery) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dementia 13
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After John Haloran dies, his wife, Louise, fears that she will be denied his inheritance. Fabricating a story about John traveling to the United States, she joins the rest of the Haloran family at their Irish estate as they hold a memorial for John's sister, who died in a lake eight years ago. Louise schemes to convince Lady Haloran that she can speak with the dead child. However, this plan is interrupted by an axe murderer loose on the estate. (Horror, Thriller) - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Woman on Pier 13
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Communists blackmail a San Francisco shipper (Robert Ryan) and recruit his wife's (Laraine Day) brother (John Agar) with a blonde. (Crime drama) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Thirteen Frightened Girls
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A diplomat's teenage daughter (Kathy Dunn) spies with the daughters of diplomats from 12 different countries. (Thriller) - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: 13 Ghosts
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Cyrus Zorba and his poverty-stricken family inherit an old mansion, they can't believe their good luck. However, not long after they move in they realize that the house is haunted by 12 ghosts and run by a housekeeper who works in the dark arts. Though the ghosts are intent on killing a member of the family, the Zorbas insist on staying in the house because they have learned that a large fortune is hidden somewhere inside it. (Horror) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Hour of 13
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An 1890s jewel thief (Peter Lawford) is wrongly blamed for murder by a Scotland Yard detective (Roland Culver) on his trail. - 1952

actionmax.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
actionmax.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

actionmax.us.title: Atomic Blonde
actionmax.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, Thriller, LGBTQ) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Companion
actionmax.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire. (Thriller, Science fiction, Horror, Dark comedy) - 2025

actionmax.us.title: Us
actionmax.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

actionmax.us.title: The Apparition
actionmax.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

actionmax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
actionmax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

actionmax.us.title: A Hard Day's Night
actionmax.us.description: The Beatles in their feature film debut, one of the greatest rock-and-roll comedy adventures ever. The film has a fully restored negative and digitally restored soundtrack. The film takes on the just-left-of-reality style of mock-documentary, following "a day in the life" of John, Paul, George, and Ringo as fame takes them by storm. (Musical comedy) - 1964

actionmax.us.title: Blood Simple
actionmax.us.description: "Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1984

actionmax.us.title: Isle of Dogs
actionmax.us.description: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (Animated, Comedy, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Batman
actionmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

actionmax.us.title: Batman Returns
actionmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

actionmax.us.title: Batman Forever
actionmax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

actionmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
actionmax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

actionmax.us.title: Joker

Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. (Crime drama) - 2019

actionmax.us.title: Joker: Folie à Deux

actionmax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)

Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

actionmax.us.title: Parental Guidance

It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. moremax.us.title: Contagion
moremax.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Mickey 17
moremax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Opus
moremax.us.description: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan. (Thriller, Horror, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Papillon
moremax.us.description: The epic story of Henri Papillon Charrière, a safecracker from the Parisian underworld who is framed for murder and condemned to life in the notorious penal colony on Devil's Island. Determined to regain his freedom, Papillon forms an unlikely alliance with convicted counterfeiter Louis Dega, who in exchange for protection, agrees to finance Papillon's escape. (Adventure, Historical drama, Biography) - 2017

moremax.us.title: The Mountain Between Us
moremax.us.description: Stranded on a mountain after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must work together to endure the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles of wilderness, pushing each other to survive and discovering their inner strength. (Adventure, Drama, Romance) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Repo Men
moremax.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

moremax.us.title: A Thousand Words
moremax.us.description: Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) is a selfish literary agent whose fast-talking ways allow him to close any deal. His next target is New Age guru Dr. Sinja (Cliff Curtis), but the savvy doctor sees right through Jack. A magical tree appears in Jack's yard, and, according to Dr. Sinja, the tree and Jack are connected; every time Jack says a word, a leaf falls from the tree. When the last leaf drops, Jack will die. With just a thousand leaves left, Jack must learn to curb his speech, or he's a goner. (Comedy) - 2012

moremax.us.title: The Art of Getting By
moremax.us.description: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix. (Comedy drama) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Smoking Tigers
moremax.us.description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends. (Drama) - 2023

moremax.us.title: The Alto Knights
moremax.us.description: In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (Crime drama) - 2025

moremax.us.title: The Judge
moremax.us.description: Hank Palmer (Robert Downey Jr.), a brilliant but shady attorney, returns to his Indiana hometown after learning that his mother has passed away. His arrival triggers renewed tension between himself and his father, Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall), who makes no secret of his disapproval of Hank's morally ambiguous career. As the lawyer prepares to depart, his father is arrested for a hit-and-run death. Hank takes on his father's defense, despite the objections of the resentful old man. (Drama) - 2014

moremax.us.title: Camp Hell
moremax.us.description: Horrific events plague a teen when his parents send him to a Christian camp. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

moremax.us.title: Black Butterfly
moremax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Shazam!
moremax.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
moremax.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Tomb Raider
moremax.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Trap
moremax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

moremax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
moremax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

moremax.us.title: DC League of Super-Pets
moremax.us.description: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2022

moremax.us.title: Miss Sloane
moremax.us.description: Willing to bend the rules for her clients, Elizabeth Sloane (Jessica Chastain) remains one of the most sought-after lobbyists in Washington, D.C. When asked to help oppose a bill that imposes regulations on firearms, she instead joins a scrappy boutique firm that represents the backers of the law. Her defiant stance and determination to win now makes her the target of powerful new enemies who threaten her career and the people she cares about. (Drama, Thriller) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Black Adam
moremax.us.description: In ancient Kahndaq, Teth Adam was bestowed the almighty powers of the gods. After using these powers for vengeance, he was imprisoned, becoming Black Adam. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2022

moremax.us.title: Lady Bird

moremax.us.title: Mojave
moremax.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (Thriller) - 2015

moremax.us.title: The Perfect Match
moremax.us.description: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
moremax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E3 Family Meal There is nothing more important to Lidia than gathering around the table with her family to share a meal. She makes balsamic chicken stir fry, a traditional frico recipe, and grape ricotta pizza.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E6 Aoc Of Cheeses Of Switzerland Will samples raclette and learns how it's made the traditional way over a wood fire. His journey takes him on to the pretty town of Gruyere to look at the origins of its namesake cheese.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E9 Paternoster By The Sea Warren is heading out of Cape Town into the more quiet coastal area of the Western Cape, and the picturesque town of Paternoster.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E14 Cannes In Cannes, Luana enjoys a day devoted to balance, pleasure, and discovery.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Roros, Norway In each episode, chef Tareq Taylor explores a Nordic region, searching out fantastic ingredients, meeting extraordinary people, and preparing his own versions of delicious recipes along the way.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E1 Chilli Crab, Chilli Fish, Fried Rice, Shellfish Salad Mitch and Ali travel 140 kms north of Broome to Mercedes Cove, a must-visit tourist destination to take in the amazing country, with William Bin Kali and -Petronella Channing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E20 Catering For Different Tastes Maggie goes to extraordinary lengths to find the perfect gluten free pastry for pies, while Simon makes his own mung bean noodles with a vegetarian stock that makes his meal not just gluten free.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E34 Episode 34 Laura and produce expert Catherine Velisha are on the farm making Chicken and Celery Sandwiches. Charlie Carrington elevates camp fare with his Turmeric Chicken Skewers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E4 Beef Brutus Rachael revisits her classic Beef Brutus, a steak and Caesar salad dish she created while writing her first cookbook.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E3 Episode 3 This week, Luca shines a spotlight on a modest yet richly flavoured ingredient: aubergines. Known for their ability to soak up flavours, these versatile veggies take centre stage in recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Strait To The Plate
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Npa Tombstone Aaron is invited back to the community of New Mapoon to celebrate a Tombstone opening. With 1500 guests coming for dinner, it's all hands on deck!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E29 Episode 29 From the iconic fresh food markets, 2025 MasterChef winner Laura Sharrad hosts My Market Kitchen with loads of delicious recipes, plenty of guests and a few surprises.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Episode 9 Featuring Associate Professor Alex Pinto, Gary cooks a simple yoghurt chicken curry, fresh milk curds with honey and rhubarb, and toasted barley risotto.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E58 Episode 58 Adam Swanson has a recipe today that will take you back to your childhood, One Pot-Chorizo and Chickpea Wagon Wheel Pasta!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E4 Fast, Fab & Fruity It's a guaranteed flavour sensation as drag legend Art Simone, chef Jerry Mai and Adam cook food that's fast, fab and fruity.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Outback Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 Today Justine prepares a dish showcasing products from a local family run mango farm, followed by a visit to the pristine Berry Springs Nature Park, and catches up with Radek Zalsky at Wharf One.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Girl's Guide to Hunting, Fishing and Wild Cooking
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 New Life Analiese tackles the ups-and-downs of her new life, going on her first wallaby hunt and dealing with the wild rabbits that are decimating her garden, resulting in a delicious braised rabbit stew.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: High Country Farm
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Meet The Family We meet New Zealand's Celebrity Chef Nadia Lim, her farmer husband Carlos Bagrie, their two boys Bohi and River on their 1200 acre farm 'Royalburn Station' situated in the Queenstown Lakes region.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Elements Of A Great Bar Join Tony on his quest to characterize the perfect bar in New York City. Discover the importance of a maniacal bartender and the proper chemical makeup of drinks.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 The Struggle For The Soul Of America Tony travels to the grain-belt capital of Minneapolis, Minnesota to experience firsthand the conflict between creative independent operators and generic franchises.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E23 Humpty Dumpty Lucia and Simon are in the Wiggly Kitchen and come across an egg. Sing along to a nursery rhyme favourite 'Humpty Dumpty'. Now Simon and Lucia have three cracked eggs and they can't waste them, what to do?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E11 Tony and the Rolling Stones Tony tries to move a boulder blocking the trail.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mecha Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E52 The Big Ice When Marwyn runs out of ice, the Martians send a giant hunk of ice. The Mechas have to stop the ice from sliding into a skyscraper!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S25 E1 A Thomas Promise When Thomas and Diesel both want to deliver the same load to Whiff's Recycling Plant, Thomas suggests they each take half of the load, but Diesel turns it into a race.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E43 The Carnival The Carnival has come to town and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things. There is Mr Bull's Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr Potato.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E44 Mr Bull's New Road When Peppa takes Goldie the Fish for a visit to the vets, she is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Fleeced The Farmer decides it's time to give the flock a shearing. But when they see his first attempt, Shaun and co plan their escape.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 Sunday Roast It's the great 'Sunday Roast', the day when the Potatodons' hides are extra hot, crispy and delicious!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E41 Dinner Party Snooty King and Queen Marigold invite themselves round for dinner to King and Queen Thistle's Castle to sample Nanny Plum's cooking. Nanny, 'the best cook in the world', tries hard to cook 'special modern food'.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E32 Junk Art When a wheel-less golf buggy is dumped in the plaza, the neighbourhood kids band together to turn junk into art.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E14 Dastardly Dumpster Lab Rat and Otto drop trash on Kittydale.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E33 Kiko's Song Santi and crew travel into the rainforest.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E46 Flashcar to the Moon / Catboy's Tiny Problem Catboy would rather be a superhero than babysit Tiny Timmy.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E10 The Octonauts And The Mudskippers The Octonauts attempt to keep the peace amongst a trio of mudskippers whose home has been flooded.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 The Sheep Badge The Squirrels are playing with their toys when they notice that there is a sheep in the clubhouse. Wait a minute! There are sheep everywhere! Inside and out! How did that happen?!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E19 Beach N Bush In an attempt to prove which is best - the beach or the bush - Gemma and Spyke take the Junior Junior Cadets on a fun day of adventure that almost ends in disaster.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S14 E23 Keep Calm and Upwards Octopus Despite constant interruptions, Mandy tries to stay calm and earn her yoga badge - until disaster strikes and she needs to be rescued from a cliff ledge!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 Nikhil and Jay and the Happy Hospital Nikhil and Jay make a hospital at home. They look after Nana and Jim, Amma and Appa and try lots of ways to make their patient.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E24 Land of the Giants One, Two, Three, Four and Five come with Fifty to a stage. Fifty rocks out and then shows a device that can make anything 10 times bigger.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Monster Makes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 Quiet, Please! Murphi's noisy tummy means Rebecca can't finish her book. They need some Monster Make ideas, fast! Perhaps tiger bread toast, a dish of fish and a bottle street will save the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E29 Icky Icky Wah Wah Mittens and Pants try to figure out the words to DJ Swimfins'; song 'Icky Icky Wah Wah'. But it seems no matter who they ask, everyone has a different idea what the lyrics are.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School: Rainforest Rangers
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S376 E4 Weather in the Rainforest Rangers Abi and Luke pack their bags with everything they need for all kinds of rainforest weather! They use different items to make storm sounds and tell the story of a sugar glider searching for somewhere to sleep.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Wiggles: Wiggle and Learn ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E19 Episode 19 It's raining outside the Wiggle House! What to do? Join The Wiggles for fun and games indoors until the rain stops!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E21 Sailing Fizzy and Suds ride a sailboat! They feel the wind fill the sails, watch a sailor prep, and learn boat parts like hull, keel, rudder, and wheel that help steer and keep the boat steady.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: L'il Stompers ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E44 L'il Bit of Magic DeeDee finds a special stick she believes has magical powers and shares her discovery with the other dinos. They have fun learning that their imaginations are the best magic of all.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E18 Perfect Pair Ginger and the Peas help a lost Avocadodon find its perfect pair with a head-rubbing ritual.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E29 Water Lily Origami When life becomes stressful, think of the peaceful waterlily! Tammy helps Tommy and Kai discover mindfulness with origami.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy's Wild Workouts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 Arctic On this adventure Andy travels to the freezing Arctic to see what he can find. He leaps with an arctic fox, and swims with eider ducks before meeting a huge, hungry polar bear.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E59 Lost and Flounder Lorelai accidentally loses a magical Merlandian artifact and learns how to stay calm in order to recover it from Pepito.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Super-Fan SuperKitty super-fan, Pickles, helps the team save the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E8 Big Day Out Badge It's a beautiful day, so Duggee hires a big yellow bus and takes the Squirrels and their parents (and in some cases, grandparents) to where exactly? Well it's a surprise!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Shadowlands On a picnic in the park, Bluey and her friends play Shadowlands. But when Coco keeps taking shortcuts, Bluey has to show her that following the rules can make the game more fun.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S11 E30 Fairyland It’s the last day of the holiday but the adventure isn’t over yet! The families adventure through the forest to find the fairies! After an all-day trip they arrive to the fairy spot and receive gifts from the fairies before heading back home.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E57 Superhero Party It's Pedro Pony's birthday and he is having a superhero party. Pedro is dressed up like Super Potato and to Pedro's surprise all the children are also dressed like Super Potato.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kiri and Lou
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E1 Grow Lou explains that growing is inevitable.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Big Lizard
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E15 The Triple Eclipse A triple solar eclipse is about to happen! Cosima and Big Lizard race down the volcano and hitch a lift on a dragonfly to get vital equipment to Dad in the nick of time.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E34 The Octonauts And The Jelly Fish Bloom When Shellington gets trapped in the middle of a massive Jellyfish bloom, it's up to the Octonauts to rescue him!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 Brave In The Waves When Pounce pretends he's an expert at diving under big waves, his friends ask him to teach them how - and he soon finds himself in deep trouble.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Super Monsters
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E2 The Impossible Seed The Super Monsters show teamwork makes the impossible possible by growing a magical seed together.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E28 Bad Bot Doc Ock creates a \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 The Weekend At the weekend, Bluey and Bingo are playing in the garden with Dad. But Bingo gets upset when she discovers a walking leaf insect and Dad is too caught up in the game to notice.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E15 Stuck Cat When Flour gets stuck on top of the music shop, the kids and Penny must find a way to get him down.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E34 Lucy's Elf and Fairy Party Lucy celebrates her birthday with an Elf and Fairy party. Lucy's Dad does a magic show but things get a bit out of hand when Princess Holly and her friends join in.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piripenguins
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Top of the Swaps Facing some tricky problems, the Piris find clever solutions through swapping items.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E18 Teething Problems Evil Pea gets annoyed by Supertato's winning smile, so she takes all the toothpaste in the Supermarket!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Batwheels
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E15 Save the Bat Dance For Me Redbird is convinced that nobody likes his eccentric dance moves, but when Toyman traps Robin behind a dance-themed gauntlet, it's up to the rambunctious rally car to dance his way to victory.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E6 Stumpfest Dad and his mates hit the backyard, ready to rip up some tree stumps! But when Bluey and Bingo take over a stump as a nail salon, Dad finds he's got some negotiating to do.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E12 Men at Work When the Farmer discovers he's sprung a leak, he calls the Water Board to come and fix the problem. The bored Flock are thrilled by the opportunity to have some watery fun. When the workmen clock off, the party begins!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ninjago ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E4 Misfortune Rising The Ninja are on a collision course; to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E17 A German Folk Song and an Actual Adult Georgie goes on a birthday date and Mary confronts Brenda about her relationship with George. Also, Sheldon takes an interest in Missy's favourite TV show.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BtN Newsbreak ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E202 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E18 Little Green Men and a Fella's Marriage Proposal Sheldon wants to search for life on other planets, and Mandy answers Georgie's marriage proposal. Also, Missy is caught between two friends.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Animal Park
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S17 E1 Episode 1 There are festive celebrations in the park with new arrivals from afar. It's a nerve-wracking time as keepers mix them with current residents. Love at first sight or claws at dawn?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Secret Life of the Koala
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 Koala Country This episode explores how life varies for koalas in different parts of Australia.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Merlin

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E23 The Five Doctors The Doctor returns to Gallifrey only to discover that a deadly game banned and derelict for centuries, has been reactivated. Soon he finds his other selves have also been summoned to assist him in tracing the culprit and tracking down the secret Rassilon.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E1 Warriors of the Deep: Part 1 Seabase 4 is on alert. A strange craft is approaching but the crew has been infiltrated by the enemy, so Commander Vorshak's solutions are stopped at every turn.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E2 Warriors of the Deep: Part 2 The Silurians and Sea Devils send the Myrka in as a spearhead to the invasion of the Seabase, whilst Nilson and Doctor Solow work to bring the entire Bloc down.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E3 Warriors of the Deep: Part 3 As Vorshak’s crew are cut down one by one by Sauvix's Sea Devil Warriors, the Doctor is running out of ways to broker a peace between mammal and reptile.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E4 Warriors of the Deep: Part 4 Lethal hexachromite gas is used against the invaders and the Doctor is despondent that no one wants to find another way to avoid so much death.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E5 The Awakening: Part 1 Teacher Jane Hampden is increasingly frustrated by the war games being played around the village, but the Doctor is more alarmed to find a boy transported from the 17th century.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E6 The Awakening: Part 2 The Malus’s influence is asserting itself all over Little Hodcombe, and the war games take an unpleasant turn. The Doctor’s best defence is in the TARDIS - but the Malus is inside.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E7 Frontios: Part 1 Captain Revere is the latest person to be sucked beneath the ground on Frontios, leaving the young Plantagenet to run the colony. The Doctor’s TARDIS has also been destroyed.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E8 Frontios: Part 2 Trying to discover why Frontios is being attacked from both above and below, the Doctor faces the malevolent Tractators while revolution brews in the colony.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E9 Frontios: Part 3 Turlough’s race memories of the Frontios threaten to overwhelm him as the Doctor finally convinces Brazen that the threat from underground is very real.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E10 Frontios: Part: 4 The Doctor manipulates the Gravis into restoring the TARDIS, but still has to find a way to break the Tractators’ hold over Frontios before they wipe out all life on the surface.

BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E12 Resurrection of the Daleks: Part 2 As survivors of the prison station fight the invaders, Dalek agents on Earth take steps to protect the time corridor being used by the Doctor's friends.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E13 Planet of Fire: Part 1 On the planet Sarn, the truth about the god Logar is being searched for, while on Earth Peri wants a break from her stepfather. But the Master has other plans for everyone.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E14 Planet of Fire: Part 2 Kamelion has taken the TARDIS to Sarn and is trying to locate his master, while the Doctor explores the mystery of the Misos Triangle - much to Turlough's consternation.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E15 Planet of Fire: Part 3 Logar is angry and the volcano shakes with his displeasure – according to Timanov, who demands sacrifices to appease his god. Peri discovers the Master's whereabouts.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E16 Planet of Fire: Part 4 The Doctor is forced to take drastic measures against Kamelion and the Master to stop Sarn being completely destroyed by the numismaton gas that has been released.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E17 The Caves of Androzani: Part 1 Gunrunners are on Androzani Minor, supplying the rebellious android-builder Sharez Jek with munitions to help his attempts to return to power. But not everyone is happy about that.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E18 The Caves of Androzani: Part 2 Military captive Salateen tells Peri and the Doctor they are dying from spectrox tomaemia and the only cure is the milk of the queen bat, who sleeps deep below the caverns.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E19 The Caves of Androzani: Part 3 As Morgus continues to plot his political future on Androzani Major, Sharez Jek insanely believes Peri will fall in love with him. The Doctor is caught by the gunrunners.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E20 The Caves of Androzani: Part 4 Morgus is ruined, exposed as the one funding Jek’s gunrunners, and Jek himself goes on a murderous rampage. Although dying from spectrox tomaemia the Doctor saves Peri.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E21 The Twin Dilemma: Part 1 The mysterious Professor Edgeworth has kidnapped twin human child genii, Romulus and Remus, and Hugo Lang holds the new Doctor responsible for the destruction of his spaceship.

BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E23 The Twin Dilemma: Part 3 Mestor claims that all he wants is for the Sylvest twins to help him repopulate his home planet but the Doctor knows there’s more to this than meets the eye.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E24 The Twin Dilemma: Part 4 Mestor’s true plan is revealed and the Doctor's old Gallifreyan friend Azmael comes to the realisation that he has been corrupted long enough by the Gastropod leader.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E1 Attack of the Cybermen: Part 1 The Cybermen are hiding in the London sewers and turning humans into semi-cybernetic slaves. On Telos two slaves make a bid of freedom and find a way to escape the planet for good.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E2 Attack of the Cybermen: Part 2 On Telos the Doctor is reintroduced to the Cyber Leader and meets the Cryons, the planet’s original inhabitants who want their planet back and will go to any lengths to do so.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E3 Vengeance on Varos: Part 1 Needing Zeiton 7 ore urgently for the TARDIS, the Doctor takes Peri to Varos, but quickly become part of the sadistic programming that entertains the populace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E4 Vengeance on Varos: Part 2 As Peri and Areta begin to transform into a bird and a reptile, the Doctor faces Sil, who has negotiated mining rights on Varos, depriving the Time Lord of what he needs...

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E5 The Mark of the Rani: Part 1 People cannot sleep in the town of Killingworth and the Doctor realises it is the work of a renegade Time Lord, the Rani, who has teamed up with the Master to wreck chaos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E6 The Mark of the Rani: Part 2 George Stephenson and Luke Ward do their best to help the Doctor and Peri, but the Rani has other traps for the unwary, including the ability to turn people into trees...

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Mathieu and Alice shared a romance about fifteen years ago before parting ways. Mathieu, now in his fifties, is an actor based in Paris. Alice, in her forties, works as a piano teacher in a coastal town. Their paths cross once again years later.

kdsm.us.title: The Floor ᴺᵉʷ
kdsm.us.description: Contestants must stand their ground on a massive, interactive LED game floor of squares, each representing a different trivia category. The first challenger, selected at random, must choose one of his or her neighboring opponents to go head-to-head in an epic quiz duel in the opponent's category. The winner takes over the loser's square, gaining valuable ground as they expand their territory, while the loser exits the game. The winner must then choose whether to go on the offensive to dominate more of the board or let The Floor choose a new challenger. The contestant who gains full control over The Floor takes home a life-changing grand prize. (Game show) - 2023-12-25

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Bebé al horno; Amor equino

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. wxix.us.description: Contestants must stand their ground on a massive, interactive LED game floor of squares, each representing a different trivia category. The first challenger, selected at random, must choose one of his or her neighboring opponents to go head-to-head in an epic quiz duel in the opponent's category. The winner takes over the loser's square, gaining valuable ground as they expand their territory, while the loser exits the game. The winner must then choose whether to go on the offensive to dominate more of the board or let The Floor choose a new challenger. The contestant who gains full control over The Floor takes home a life-changing grand prize. (Game show) - 2023-12-25

fxm.us.title: Don't Breathe 2
fxm.us.description: Blind veteran Norman Nordstrom has been hiding out for several years in an isolated cabin. He lives with a young girl and has recreated the family stolen from him by a drunken driver. Their quiet life together is soon shattered when a group of unseemly criminals kidnaps her. Norman is now forced to tap into even darker and more creative instincts in an effort to save her. (Thriller, Horror, Action, Crime drama) - 2021

fxm.us.title: Ready or Not
fxm.us.description: Grace couldn't be happier after she marries the man of her dreams at his family's luxurious estate. There's just one catch -- she must now hide from midnight until dawn while her new in-laws hunt her down with guns, crossbows and other weapons. As Grace desperately tries to survive the night, she soon finds a way to turn the tables on her not-so-lovable relatives. (Horror, Thriller, Dark comedy) - 2019

fxm.us.title: Mothering Sunday
fxm.us.description: With her employers away, a housemaid sneaks off to spend quality time with her secret lover -- a man who's engaged to another woman. (Romance, Drama) - 2021

fxm.us.title: Lucy in the Sky
fxm.us.description: After an awe-inspiring experience in outer space, an astronaut returns to Earth and starts to lose touch with reality in a world that now seems too small. (Drama) - 2019

fxm.us.title: How to Steal a Million
fxm.us.description: Charles Bonnet (Hugh Griffith) expresses his passion for art by forging masterpieces -- and selling them at a hefty profit. The trouble starts when his reproduction of a prized sculpture winds up in a famous Paris museum. If experts determine that it is inauthentic, Bonnet's reputation will be tarnished. That's why his fetching daughter, Nicole (Audrey Hepburn), hires cat burglar Simon Dermott (Peter O'Toole) to steal the sculpture back before it's too late. (Comedy) - 1966

fxm.us.title: The Quiller Memorandum
fxm.us.description: After two British Secret Intelligence Service agents are murdered at the hands of a cryptic neo-Nazi group known as Phoenix, the suave agent Quiller is sent to Berlin to investigate. There, he begins an affair with Inge Lindt, a beautiful young teacher. However, their lives are put in danger after Quiller is kidnapped and taken to Phoenix's headquarters, where he meets Oktober, the mysterious leader of the group. (Thriller) - 1966

fxm.us.title: The Kremlin Letter
fxm.us.description: When an unauthorized letter is sent to Moscow alleging the U.S. government's willingness to help Russia attack China, former naval officer Charles Rone and his team are sent to retrieve it. They go undercover, successfully reaching out to Erika Kosnov, the wife of a former agent, now married to the head of Russia's secret police. Their plans are interrupted, however, when their Moscow hideout is raided by a cunning politician. (Thriller) - 1970

fxm.us.title: Dirty Mary, Crazy Larry
fxm.us.description: Down on their luck and out of cash, high-speed racer Larry (Peter Fonda) and his repairman (Adam Roarke) plan to hold up a supermarket that's fat with a fresh payroll. Larry hopes to score enough to buy his ideal car, and then join the professional league. At the last minute, their heist is complicated by the addition of Larry's on-off girlfriend (Susan George), who's all jazzed up for the burglary. Larry's racing skills will be pushed to the limit in this chase-packed action thriller. (Action) - 1974

fxm.us.title: Race With the Devil
fxm.us.description: Roger (Peter Fonda), his friend Frank (Warren Oates), and their wives (Lara Parker, Loretta Swit) are heading from San Antonio to the wilderness of rural Texas for some off-road motocross. What they find instead is a Satanic cult sacrifice, and they are unfortunate enough to be caught observing the ritual. Naturally, this doesn't sit too well with the cult members. Now Roger and Frank are on the run from what is apparently a very sizable Texan Satanist community. (Horror) - 1975

fxm.us.title: The Fury
fxm.us.description: When a devious plot separates CIA agent Peter Sandza (Kirk Douglas) from his son, Robin (Andrew Stevens), the distraught father manages to see through the ruse. Taken because of his psychic abilities, Robin is being held by Ben Childress (John Cassavetes), who is studying people with supernatural powers in hopes of developing their talents as weapons. Soon Peter pairs up with Gillian (Amy Irving), a teen who has telekinesis, to find and rescue Robin. (Thriller, Horror) - 1978

fxm.us.description: Blind veteran Norman Nordstrom has been hiding out for several years in an isolated cabin. He lives with a young girl and has recreated the family stolen from him by a drunken driver. Their quiet life together is soon shattered when a group of unseemly criminals kidnaps her. fxm.us.title: The Unholy
fxm.us.description: A girl inexplicably gains the power to heal the sick after a supposed visitation from the Virgin Mary. As word spreads and people flock to witness her miracles, a disgraced journalist visits the small New England town to investigate. However, when strange events start to occur, he soon wonders if these phenomena are the result of something more sinister. (Horror, Thriller) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Night House
fxm.us.description: Reeling from the unexpected death of her husband, Beth is left alone at the lakeside home he built for her. She tries her best to keep it together -- but then the nightmares come. Disturbing visions of a presence in the house call to her, beckoning Beth with a ghostly allure. She soon begins searching for answers, only to find secrets both strange and disturbing. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

fxm.us.description: A woman's quiet life on an American farm takes a terrifying turn when the remains of her estranged mother arrive from Korea. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Fathom
fxm.us.description: While touring abroad in Europe, beautiful American skydiver Fathom Harvill (Raquel Welch) gets wrapped up in international intrigue when Scottish spy Douglas Campbell (Ronald Fraser) recruits her to help him on a secret mission. Before long, Fathom realizes that no one around her, including the mysterious Peter Merriwether (Tony Franciosa), can easily be trusted, leading to various adventures that involve bullfighting, beaches and, of course, romance. (Action) - 1967

fxm.us.title: The Horror of It All
fxm.us.description: Yankee salesman Jack (Pat Boone) wants to marry Cynthia Marley (Erica Rogers), and they travel to her family's English estate to break the good news. Cynthia warns that the family is a bit odd, which proves to be an understatement. One relative is an ex-thespian who still believes he's in a play, another behaves like a vampire and a third is imprisoned in the cellar due to his violent tendencies. But things get really sinister when the Marleys start succumbing to violent fates, one by one. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Fly
fxm.us.description: When scientist Andre Delambre (Al Hedison) tests his matter transporter on himself, an errant housefly makes its way into the transportation chamber, and things go horribly wrong. As a result, Delambre's head and arm are now that of the insect. Slowly losing himself to the fly, Delambre turns to his wife, Helene (Patricia Owens), for help. But when tragedy strikes, Delambre's brother (Vincent Price) and Inspector Charas (Herbert Marshall) are forced to pick up the investigation. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1958

fxm.us.title: The Curse of the Fly
fxm.us.description: Scantily clad Patricia Stanley (Carole Gray) breaks out of a mental hospital and is picked up by passing motorist Martin Delambre (George Baker). The two do not reveal much about themselves to each other, but nevertheless decide to get married. At the Delambre family mansion, Patricia meets Martin's father, Henri (Brian Donlevy), an eccentric scientist. Snooping about the grounds, she discovers evidence of the family's strange experiments in teleportation and the grisly results thereof. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery, Drama) - 1965

fxm.us.title: The Day the Earth Stood Still
fxm.us.description: When a UFO lands in Washington, D.C., bearing a message for Earth's leaders, all of humanity stands still. Klaatu has come on behalf of alien life who have been watching Cold War-era nuclear proliferation on Earth. But it is Klaatu's soft-spoken robot Gort that presents a more immediate threat to onlookers. A single mother and her son teach the world about peace and tolerance in this moral fable, ousting the tanks and soldiers that greet the alien's arrival. (Science fiction) - 1951

fxm.us.title: The Day Mars Invaded Earth
fxm.us.description: A Cape Canaveral scientist finds Martians reducing people to ashes and taking their places. (Science fiction) - 1963

fxm.us.title: The Earth Dies Screaming
fxm.us.description: An astronaut (Willard Parker) returns from a test flight to find England overtaken by alien-controlled robots which turn corpses into zombies. (Science fiction) - 1964

fxm.us.title: Alien
fxm.us.description: In deep space, the crew of the commercial starship Nostromo is awakened from their cryo-sleep capsules halfway through their journey home to investigate a distress call from an alien vessel. The terror begins when the crew encounters a nest of eggs inside the alien ship. An organism from inside an egg leaps out and attaches itself to one of the crew, causing him to fall into a coma. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1979
